tapes.text:
Alaykum to the Muslims. We greet you in the greeting words of peace. As-salamu alaykum. To the Christian community, in the words of Jesus, every time he met his disciples or left his disciples, he always greeted them, One love, one love. I, Mohammed, am very happy and thankful for his work and the work of Minister Abdul-Halim and the believers here in Toronto and the local organizing committee of the Million Man March under the leadership of our dear brother, our Attorney, to the great leadership of this city and the people who have backed and supported this effort, I am deeply grateful to all of you for your sincere work to make this night possible. And I would not want him to suffer any financial loss. So on behalf of Minister Donnie and all those who contributed, I want to thank you for whatever you have given.

And if at the end of the night you find that what you have received is so much more than Then perhaps on your way out there'll be a receptacle there that you may drop something in. None of this will go to Louis Farrakhan. All of this will go to defray the expense of this evening. Thank you very much. Thank you, Minister Dunn. I want to thank the press because I think if you had not built a controversy Over my coming to Toronto, everyone wouldn't have known that I was coming. I did not know that this was in fact the Jewish holiday, but I sincerely wish the members of the Jewish community a happy new year.

But I came to talk to you. Since the historic Million Man March, we have been on a world tour to bring to the people of the world the idea of atonement, reconciliation, and responsibility. The theme of atonement and the day of atonement is actually taken from Jewish history. As you know, when were in Egypt, and they came out of Egypt into the wilderness. Before they entered the Promised Land, it was revealed to Aaron that a day should be set aside for the members atone for any error or sin that they had made, that they would make an atonement to Almighty God, that he may continue to bless them in the new year as he had blessed them in the year going out. But Moses and Aaron were a sign of another time period that would come at the end of this world's time to rule.

The Bible and Holy Quran teach us that one would come like unto Moses. In fact, in the book of Deuteronomy it is written, And I will raise them up a prophet like unto thee, Moses, And I will put my words in his mouth, And he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him. Well, there cannot be a man like Moses unless there's a people like the people of Moses, and a king like Pharaoh, and a government like the government of Egypt, and a people under oppression like the children of Israel. And so if we look into history, we don't find another people in history suffering cruel cruel bondage in a strange land among strange people other than those who were brought out of Africa into the Caribbean and then into North America, where our people have suffered for four hundred and forty-one years now.

So atonement that was given to the children of Israel as a specific day, a 24-hour period, starting from sundown the night before to sundown the day of, that was to be a sign not of a literal 24-hour day, but a period where the people would have a chance to atone and repent of the evils that they have done, so that they might reconcile themselves first to God before God wreaks his destruction on the current world and its system of things. So, in that spirit of atonement, which is not anymore a twenty-four hour period, but all of us now have to reconcile ourselves first to Almighty God. We have to understand that we have been made to deviate from His way, from His straight path, from the teachings of all of the prophets, so much so that it looks today like a prophet of God has never walked among the human family.

The human being who is the greatest of God's creation, no matter what color we may be, we are acting after the similitude of the beasts of the field and the creeping and crawling things of the earth. And so when we do that, we do not justify our existence on the earth. So now the forces of nature, directed by God, are moving human beings to the valley of decision. We're going to have to decide whether we're going to obey God or whether we're going to obey man. And in that decision that we make, there will be a separation between the weak and the tare, the sheep and the goat, the righteous and the wicked, whatever color they may be. So in this process of atonement, I recognize that there is difficulty for me, because I don't wish to offend any of the laws of Canada, and I don't intend to.

And I certainly am not here to try to pit one group against another, one religion against another, or blacks against whites, or whites against blacks, or blacks against Jews. That is not my purpose. That is not my purpose. I'm afraid you're going to be disappointed. But my aim is to speak truth out of the spirit of love, not to say that I might get in trouble for speaking the truth. It depends. I want you to hear me, because it's not right that anybody should promote hatred of another human being.

That is against the law of God as well as the law of man. Because, in fact, the way you all write about me and the way you talk about me, it is as though you want people to hate me, and you would hope that that hate would be so intense that some good person would take my life. And this seems to be a willful motive, but I don't see the law being applied for me to defend and protect me from slander and hatred. So my job is very difficult, and the reason my assignment is difficult, because in the process of atonement, the first thing that must be done is that truth has to be told in government, in people, in institutions. Not that we should hate government, hate institutions, hate the thing that is wrong, but truth is told so that one might correct oneself, government might correct herself, institutions might be corrected, that government, institutions, and people may come into the favor of God, because the way we are going now, God is angry with the nations and the people.

I want you to hear me. Though I can't tickle your ears and make you feel good, I have to please Almighty God. And if I please Him, if the world is displeased, it really doesn't matter to me. The fact that I am popular with you is because you know that Jesus said, You shall know the truth, and the truth will set you free. So since I've never been to Canada to speak before, and this is my first time in this country to speak, then you would ask, why did all the people come out, thousands on the outside, angry, because they couldn't get in. And yet, if the politicians called a meeting, they couldn't get across. And many of the religious leaders could not get a crown.

Why is this? Why is this? Because you have compromised the principles of truth to seek the favor of those that you think are in power are there by the permission of God, and that may be temporary. So what you have to do is decide what side of this you're going to be on. If you're going to be on the side of truth, you will suffer a little while, because this world has always persecuted the bearers of truth. They have imprisoned the bearers of truth. Some of the bearers of truth have been killed. But none of us is greater than truth.

So to suffer, or to be imprisoned, or even to be killed for the sake of truth, we are We are no better than the prophets that went before us, who suffered and were persecuted for the sake of truth? So if that is my lot or your lot, so be it. So be it. But the prophets, the prophets, no matter how long they lived or how short they lived, their name is recorded in history, and every time their name is mentioned, the words flow from the lips of those who live after them, peace be unto them and peace be unto their families. So it doesn't matter how long you live, but what matters is the quality of life and the service that you render to God and to speak the truth without fear, not breaking your law, but using your law.

Because a righteous person respects those in authority, and a righteous person respects the law, as long as that law does not conflict with our religion. Right? Well, let's get down to business. and the Day of Atonement was called by us to answer a specific need in the black community in America, and we found that that need is worldwide. Black people today in America, here in Canada, in the isles of the Caribbean and in Africa, have been set at each other. Our differences are exploited, and we have become now the greatest enemies of self and our own advancement. wrong if we are 5% of the population in Toronto and nearly 50% of those confined for criminal action. Something is wrong. Something is wrong in the jails and federal penitentiaries of America.

America has the largest population of criminals anywhere to be found in the world. One point six million is the recorded number. There may be more. One point six million prisoners. So today the fastest growing industry in America is the prison industrial complex. The legislatures have fed three strikes, and you're in prison for life. A few years ago, the statistics were that one out of every four black people in the United States was either in prison or connected to the criminal justice system. Now it's one in three. So there's hardly any young black person that has not offended the law. So from teenagers, we may run into trouble with the law, and by the time we're twenty, we may have three offenses.

No matter what those offenses are, three offenses, and you're locked down for the rest of your natural life. it's a modern form of slavery using crime, using crime as the excuse to put black and brown people under penalty for the rest of their natural life, tying them to nearly free labor, with the industries now tied to prisons. So in America it is true that the newest buildings going up are stadiums for sport, and modern, ultra-modern prisons tied to industry. Then, of course, there is the drug business. Cocaine, in the powdered form, is something that poor folk just cannot afford. A little ganja here and there, that's the poor man's high. Now that means that crack spreading in the black community is a means to put you in prison, trust perishing in the black community, is a means of putting us in prison for long term. I want you to hear me. If you don't mind, the person on the sound, could you turn it up a little, please? Just a little. Yourself. You want to see how you was looking. Well when you go to school, you have to connect to education, and education has to connect to you, otherwise education becomes a slave-making device. And if you go to the mosque or the synagogue or the church to pray and partake of rituals, but you do not understand the depth and the meaning and the truth of Scripture, that the Word of God is not a stagnant thing. The Word of God is a living thing that will keep on revealing new and deeper truths to you the more you look and study the Word of God. Now, to my Muslim brothers and sisters, you know, this book, Qur'an, is supposed to last a human family up to the day of judgment. That means that the ever-deepening understanding of the Word of God contained in this book will give you the key to solve the problems of modern-day society. If there's a social sickness here, there's disease here, where is the medicine? There are mosques all over the world and churches all over the world and synagogues and temples all over the world, but human beings are degenerating. Where is the healing? Then somebody needs to look more deeply into the Word of God than what is presently here. holiness was asking the right question, you all should forgive. But I said to His Holiness, Yeah, Your Holiness, but that is the fifth stage in the process. Listen, breaks it all the way down in order to build it up again new. You can't tell me you met Jesus, and you're the same old Negro, thinking the same old thoughts, doing the same old thing. If you met Jesus, you are a new creature. I'm a Baptist. What about you said you was a Jehovah's Witness? I'm that too. Jehovah means the self-existent God, and the one by whom all things exist. If you're a witness of Him, and all of us should be a witness of the God that created us, then every one of you should want to be a witness of Jehovah.

Because in Isaiah he said, ye are what? My witnesses. But you can't be a witness of God if God has not come into your life. See, you've got to know that there's a God in my life, yet the world hates me, but yet the poor hear me gladly, and the world wants to destroy me but can't seem to do it, and I must have been covered by and protected by a force that the world don't know yet, if they talk about me like a dog, write about me like a dog, trying to make people hate me before they meet me. But yet when they meet the brother, and the brother speaks, it begins to vanish all the thoughts you used to think. Now, when I say I am a Muslim, I am a Christian, I am a Jew. To be a Muslim means one who submits to do the will of God, following the example of Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. And what is a Christian? One crystallized into oneness with God following the example of Jesus Christ. What is a Jew? Way down in what is called the jungles of Africa. They may not have had a Bible, and they may not have had a holy Qur'an, but they were born into the universal book of God where everything in His book is truth. And they studied that book, the native Indian, the native black, and when they're left alone, if you watch them, they built societies that had law and order in their tribes. They had tribal customs, and if you look at the way they live, their law, and then you look at what Moses taught, Moses didn't bring nothing new except to those that he taught. But that law is law among all of the civilized people, and even those in the jungle got a law that they lived by. And if you took time to study them, rather than say they're heathens, they could have taught the European a lot.

But he was so arrogant. The Mayans were so far advanced beyond the Europeans that the Europeans came and when they met the Mayans, they met them with a highly developed civilization. They knew mathematics and science, and they wrote their science in books. And the missionaries burned their books, and it took them hundreds—no, not hundreds, but a long, long time to learn what the Mayans already knew and had written, but white supremacy would not allow them to learn from the people that they call heathens. I want you to hear me, black man, because white supremacy is not Christianity. White supremacy is not righteousness. Whenever you take your color and make your color the badge of honor and somebody else's color a badge of dishonor.

You have dishonored yourself and you've shown disrespect to God and the infinite wisdom of his creation. Follow me. Follow me. Look, look at the universe. universe, a sun with nine beautiful planets. From the close planet Mercury to the far planet Pluto, all of them manifest a different color. If the planets could talk, would you hear any one of them saying, you know what, I'm better than that one because my color is so, so, so. You would say the planet is talking foolish? Look at the earth. You got brown earth, you got red earth, you got white earth, and you never hear any member of the family of earth say, I'm better, because I'm black.

That talk is reserved for foolish human beings. The rocks! Some of them black, some of them brown, some of them red, some of them white! No talk of which one has a better color. Go ahead, look at your diamonds. They reflect all the colors. Look at your rubies, put on your sapphire, put on your diamond, put on your this and your that, and you want to show off your colors, eh? But you can't say which one better than the other. Look at the flowers, look at the plants, look at the beautiful colors in the birds, look at the ants. And nobody talks that foolishness but the human being. And the reason the human being talks it is because he's sick. And I'm sorry, white people, we would never have had to talk about black if you hadn't spent so much time talking about white. You, you want everything of value to be white, and everything of non-value to be black, and you have poisoned religion.

Islam is poisoned. I want you to hear me, Muslims. I say Islam is poisoned. The practice of it, not the imam, but the practice is poison, because racism has poisoned the bloodstream of Islam. Racism has poisoned the bloodstream of Christianity. Racism has poisoned the bloodstream of Judaism. Tell me I'm a liar. So all of it is sick and in need of a doctor. And if you don't get a cure soon, God intends to wipe the slate and start again.

Did you hear me? Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, eighty days before he passed from this earth, he talked to his beloved community, and he said, and I quote, there is no superiority of the white over the black, or the Arab over the non-Arab. The best of you is he that is most careful of his or her duty to God. Why did he say that? Because he saw the seed of racism right in his own community, and he knew what was coming. He knew that you would be taken off the path by Satan! Muslims! You're in trouble because you deviated from the path of God. That's why you're in trouble. And if you don't come back to the path of God, you will be destroyed. You are now weak as a community when God raised you to be the guide for humanity. Now the human family is laughing at you. Listen to me. You're in the United Nations, all these Muslim nations.

Just like the Quran says, you would take this book and put it behind your backs, because the leaders don't judge with this book, they don't rule with this book. They rule. And And they say, la ilaha illallah, there is no God but Allah, and his partner is the government of the United States. So they obey Washington. They obey the United Nations. And they forsake the Quran. And the other members of the Muslim world won't send them weapons to defend themselves because there's an embargo. God didn't put the embargo on them. America did. And you will bow down to America instead of bowing down to Allah. You let America put sanctions on Iraq.

You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story.

You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. You don't know the real story. I don't have time to tell it all, but I'm going to tell some of it. Everywhere the British went, everywhere the British ruled, when it was time for the British to get out, they would take territory from one nation and give it to another, knowing that sooner or later there would be border conflicts.

And then they'd sell weapons to one side and sell weapons to the other side. The whole way was, in fact, the 19th province of Iraq. An Iranian by the name of Mohammad Mossadegh was the leader in Iran. The British and the Americans wanted that oil. He was gradually moving the people away from Islam and persecuting people who loved Islam, but he was all right with America, because America didn't give a damn who was suffering under his rule, as long as they had access to the oil. You all all right? You don't mind me telling the truth, do you?

And while Jimmy Carter was winding and dining at the shop, you could see smoke on the White House lawn from tear gas because the Iranians in America were marching against the shop. And in the twinkling of an eye, Imam Khomeini. I don't care what you think about him, but he loved Islam. He loved Allah, and he hated what he saw the West doing to Islam. And so he came up with a revolutionary Islam, all right? He wanted to return Islam to its pristine purity, and state ruled by the laws of the Quran. There is no perfect ruler, and there's no perfect human being. He made his errors, he made his mistakes, but his intention was his love of Islam. Now hear this. In the meantime, when he talked about spreading that kind of Islam throughout that area, the shakedoms begin to quake.

Saudi begin to quake. And America said, oh no, this can't happen. And what you don't know is, the Saudis gave Iraq 80 billion dollars to make Iraq a military power as a bulwark against the rise of Imam Khomeini. Hear me, because when Khomeini came to power, all the weapons that America had poured in there were now in the hands of the revolutionaries. So America, listen! America wanted to build a bulwark against Khomeini. So they urged Saudi, look, help them. Saudi spent 80 billion dollars. 80 billion! 80 billion! This didn't come to me from a book! I got it from the mouth of Prince Benda! business in the street, I sat down with my brother. I love Arabia. That is the house, where the sacred house of Islam is.

No, no, no, Iraq got the money, but America, France, Russia, everybody that make weapons was ready to spend Saudi money. Do you hear me? Reactor. The moment the reactor was built, Israel bombed it. All that money down the drain. Nobody talk to Israel about that. I'm protecting myself because they don't deserve to have nuclear weapons. Listen, listen now, listen. Then a war was provoked between two Muslim nations. And Iran and Iraq fought each other for eight solid years, killing nearly one million of the best young Muslims in both those countries, billions of dollars of property damage, and they fought to a stalemate, but when the war was over, since America would not give any parts to Khomeini, and America took the side of Saddam. You didn't hear me? You all all right? I have never been here before, and I don't know when I'll come back again. Hopefully, hopefully, hopefully, hopefully, hopefully. And I want the government to know I'm not saying this to produce hatred for America, but I'm saying this so we can correct America. Because America stands in need to be corrected. Now, brethren, listen, when the war was over, Iraq was in a better position, still strong enough to wreak havoc in that area.

But who cares about a few Arabs in southern Lebanon? Who cares about little Iraqi babies dying? I went to the hospital. They said it was a death camp, because any time you got a hospital with no medicine, you're presiding over dying people, because you have no ability to heal them. it could be used, they said, for military purposes. I saw this with my eyes. I saw a bomb shelter. It was one of the strongest bomb shelters I had ever seen in my life. And while the young men were at the front in the South, women and children would go bomb shelter and old men. And in this bomb shelter it held about twelve hundred people. And in that bomb shelter when the bombs were falling, they went in. They told us that the bombs were for military targets. But they didn't hit military targets alone, they hit the civilian population. Here was a bomb shelter, that they sent a bomb down, one of these bombs that have a drill on it. And the bomb drilled into this building and made a hole. And then another bomb followed that bomb into the hole. And it started an explosion and there was 7,000 degrees of Fahrenheit in that building. When we went in, we saw children's flesh on the wall, in the ceiling, on the floor, and you're going to tell me that this is a human being? You're going to tell me that this is a righteous government?

And you're going to tell me that I should shut my mouth when I see that kind of stuff? If I'm a racist, why would I be concerned about what Arabs are suffering? If I'm a racist, why would I be concerned about my white Muslim brothers in Bosnia? I'm not a racist. I never have been a racist. I'm not a bigot. I love faith. I don't care what they say. I'm not a bigot. I love faith. I don't care what the faith is. I tolerate everybody's faith because that's the way the prophet of Islam was. that would attack a Jewish synagogue, turn over a Jewish gravestone, and bother Jewish people because of their Jewishness. I hate that, and I've never been guilty of that, and I wouldn't tolerate that. But that does not mean that I don't have the right to when it ill-affects black people and other people.

Now, let's get to Libya. Here is Muammar Gaddafi, a young man in his twenties. He overthrows the king in a bloodless coup in Iraq, I mean, in Libya. The oil in Libya is being taken by the British and the Americans. Very little of the oil wealth is being spread to the Libyan people. Gaddafi takes over. First thing he does is, like Mossadegh, he nationalizes the oil. That means America don't like him. That means the British don't like him. We got to look at motives here. This is a lawyer. When you deal with crime, it is the motive that you look at before you can determine what is the punishment for the crime. You You've got to see that America and England have had it in for Gaddafi ever since he kicked them out of the rulership over the oil.

Then, the British had an airbase in Tobruk. He took it back and put them out. The Americans had an airbase right outside of Tripoli called Wheeler's Air Base. He took their back and put them out. He started taking the oil revenue and sharing it with his people, building schools to educate his people. But anybody that's loved by his people and serving the people and not serving greedy corporate interests becomes an enemy to government because the Because the governments are whores. They are bought by greedy corporations. I know it hurts. I know it hurts. Somebody got to tell it. The people are dying because people are cowardly. You know the truth, but you shut your mouth because you want some favorite position.

But what position will you have in the future? Where are your children going? If somebody don't stand up and tell the truth and make a change here, all of us will die because there's madness in governments. There's madness in the political leaders. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people.

And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people. And they lie to the people to deceive you and make you think it's democracy, it's freedom and justice that they're fighting for, when all they're fighting for is advantage for the rich, and the suffering of the poor continues unabated.

Libya and Muammar Gaddafi finances liberation struggles. It's true. If you want to overthrow your government and your government was not good for the people and you were that kind of group, he would use his own money and finance you. Well, if you're a government whose corporations are sucking the blood of those nations, then you don't want a liberation struggle. You want to maintain the status quo. America's on the wrong side of history. She became free because she fought against the colonial power of the British. And now she has been on the side of every dictator on earth. This is wrong. This is wrong. My government is wrong. Somebody got to say it. She's wrong. I don't like the method. That's not my method. I told Brother Gaddafi, I'm a revolutionary. I said, but I'm not going to use no gun. Because you just go with a gun and you replace somebody, you just as foolish as the person you shot. Then you step in with your half-knowledge self, and then somebody pulls a coup on you, and then a coup, and a coup, and a coup. I said, no, no, no. I said, I've held up the Quran. I said, I'll produce my revolution with the Bible and the Quran. Because the best revolution is to change the man's heart, change the man's mind, change the way he thinks.

And then when you take on a change in your head and in your heart, then you can change your environment. And that's the kind of revolution that Prophet Muhammad was bringing about. Change of mind, change of heart, and that's why it's written in the Quran, God will never change the condition of a people until they change themselves. Some scholars say, until there's a change in your own heart, there will never be another change. God won't help you unless you make a change. And you know you need to make a change. So now they say Qaddafi bombs some discotheque in Germany, and two American service people were killed.

Reagan now orders the most expensive assassination attempt in the history of the world. Bombers flying out of England, coming down France, they said they wouldn't let them cross French territory, so they had to go down the Atlantic Ocean into the Mediterranean and refuel in the air, and then bomb Gaddafi's house. They wanted to kill the man. What did He's good for his people, bad for business. Then we find out he never was responsible for the bombing of the disco. Now they say he's responsible for Pan Am 103. Now wait, wait, wait now, it's not funny. It's not funny, because these people with this television and these newspapers, they have the power to define you. They have defined me to you.

Listen to what they say. He's a hate monger. Have you heard any hate coming out of my mouth? Listen, I don't hate my country. I was born in America. I live in America. What I hate is injustice. And if God has put it in my heart to speak truth to power, then leave me alone. I'm going to do it whether I've got any blackened of people or not. God is sufficient for me.

But because I'm a Christian, I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it.

I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I'm going to do it. I've got any basket of people or not, God is sufficient for me. But because I trust in God, you respect that, and you know that they don't buy me. You know I'm not bought, don't you? You know I'm your man, don't you? Brothers and sisters, listen to this. After Pan Am 103, they said it was the Syrians with the Iranians for almost two years. Then they changed it. Said, oh no, it was Qaddafi. Yah, yah, yah! It's Qaddafi.

And they go to the United Nations. That's what makes you know that the United Nations is weak. Because he goes to the United Nations and says, unless Qaddafi turns over the two alleged suspects, they're going to put sanctions on him. of people, over 270 lives, and an allegation that is yet to be proved true? Does that sound fair to you? No! Does that sound like justice to you? No! The families of the victims deserve justice in this matter. Gaddafi said, I'll release my nationals, but I won't release them to England or America because I don't think they'll get a fair trial. But I'll release them to any sad country. Now what, does that sound reasonable to you? He said, let them be tried at the World International Court of Justice at The Hague, and let the judge even be Scottish, and I'll turn mine over. America and England say, no! Come over to us!

Look at that arrogance. They don't want justice. They want to crush Gaddafi. Oh, it's really sad, isn't it? It's really sad. And when you go there, I watched. I was just there, you know, they voted for me to have a prize. It's called the Qaddafi Prize. And it carries with it a gift of $250,000. But the government of the United States, after Qaddafi saw the Million Man March, he called me on the telephone. And he said, Brother Farrakhan, he said, I will back the nation of Islam with the wealth of Libya. Because he saw a transformation taking place. Now they said it was a billion dollars for me? I live in a nice home, I drive nice cars, I wear nice clothes, I eat good food. I don't need the money for me.

The black man in America gets $438 billion out of the American economy, and less than one-tenth of one percent of it comes back to us because we're not providing goods and services for ourselves. So the money comes in our hands and goes right back out. But with that billion, then we could rebuild the wasted cities. We could have taken some of that money and invested it in the economies of the Caribbean and Africa. The moment Gaddafi said, I'd like to back you, you know what they did? They went and made a law right away in Congress. Don't give that fat can nothing. for the Gaddafi Prize, and I petitioned them to get the big gift for our people.

Well, they cut back on welfare, they cut off affirmative action, they cut back entitlement programs. Huh? These people are serious. They're going to balance the budget on the backs of the poor. People living under bridges, living in cardboard boxes, dying in the heat in the summer and the cold in the winter. With a billion dollars we could put construction companies to work building homes for the homeless, but they don't see that. All they see is cadets and fire cans.

They don't even call me Far Khan, they say Pan Can. So now, we have to take the US government to court. And we're going to fight it all the way. All the way. You know why? We don't believe that the United States government has any right to abridge my freedom, to accept a gift from my Muslim brother, simply because there's an allegation that he's a terrorist. what my government has done, and put it up against what Gaddafi is alleged to have done. See, we know what our government has done. America has come up with the Helms-Burton Law. They hate Cuba so much. When I was there, I had a two-hour meeting with President Castro, and he said, he said, Brother Farrakhan, we can't even buy an aspirin. Do you know that Cuba is a black country?

Seventy percent of the people in that country look just like you. And they're suffering, not because they're communists. They're suffering because of an unjust embargo because America does not like the fact that in this hemisphere Castro has chosen to go another way. Now wait a minute. Castro looks like a white man, don't he? Wait a minute.

Doesn't he? Yes he does. He looks very, very, very, very light. They would call me white in some societies. Especially in Africa, I go to, oh yeah, that's a white boy. I have to really push my lips out on him. Castro has a white father and a mestizo mother, and he told me he identified with the suffering of the poor. Well, let's see what his record is. Is that just talk? He struck down all laws that discriminate on the basis of color. He took away land from the rich. I can understand why the rich don't like him, I can understand.

I understand your point, now, I understand your point. But he took the land and he divided it up, give it to the poor. When Castro came there, ninety-five percent of the people were illiterate. Now, now, I know, I know you say he's a communist, he don't believe in God. Oh, shut up. Shut up. Do you think you believe in God? Let me show you what I mean. interview last, about two weeks, three weeks ago, with the publisher of George magazine, John Fitzgerald Kennedy, Jr. And John John, you know, I remember that young man, you know, in that tragic day when his father was being buried and the little fella was about four years old and you saw him saluting the coffin of his dad.

And he was affectionately called John John, and it was something to me to see him as a young man in his thirties, and he's coming to interview me, and during the interview, he said, why should we pay attention to the black vote in the Democratic Party when they don't wield that much influence and they don't really give any money to finance these elections. And I said, Mr. Kennedy, I said, that's the reason your party and the country are on their way to hell. I said, your problem is you cater to the rich and the influential, and you've forgotten the needs of the weak and the vulnerable in the society. I said, you are a Christian, aren't you? He said, yes. I said, a Catholic, right? He said, yes. I said, did you know that Jesus laid down the standard by which men and nations would be judged? And that standard is found raised by one of the disciples. And the question was this, Master, when were you hungry and I fed you not?

When were you naked and I clothed you not? When were you out of doors and I gave you not shelter? When were you sick and imprisoned and I ministered not unto you? And Jesus said, inasmuch as you have not done these things unto the least of these my brethren, you have not done it also unto me. I said, now, when I went to Cuba, I saw, even though food was rationed, everybody eating. everybody eat. Embargo, but everybody is getting their little piece. Free education! From nursery all the way through college. Free health! No matter what your sickness is, you can go to the hospital, and if it's an operation, whatever it is, it's free. I said, now tell me something. In Canada, get sick, and you don't have any money, or no insurance. Will they look after you? I don't know about Canada, but I know about America. Now look, education is that which gets the people ready to serve their nation and their people. But if you cannot afford to go to college, you stop at high school, and at a high school education you're unset in this global economy.

So free education should be given to the people, especially when you rob so many. Well, now I think we should wrap it all up. No, no, no, no, no, no, no. Let's, stay with me, stay with me. The, the, um, the enemy now has decided there's too many black people. So we must come up with a policy to keep them from joining on to anybody that we deem as an enemy, and we must make sure they don't change their religious thinking, and we must make sure that they never turn us out of our land. And now the aim of the policy, they decided to kill all boy babies and spare the And right now in this society, in America, Canada, the Caribbean, the black man is at risk.

And in all of the colleges and universities, it is the black woman who is getting more education, getting more qualifications. And as she gets more and more educated, the black man can't compete. He has nothing to offer her. So she'll either turn into a lesbian, or she'll be married to a Caucasian. Now look at you! Look at your condition! You have become like animals. The CIA, according to what we recently read, has put crack in the black community to finance wars in Central America and in other parts of the world. Did you know how China became weak? Because Admiral Perry and the boys introduced opium into China, China took the silver out so that China was nodding all the way, smoking the pipe, silver going out to America. Chiang Kai-shek, he forbade the smoking of opium. He gave the opium smokers a chance, clean up or die. He told the prostitutes, clean up or die. He made China strong, but he was determined, as thou hast done, so shall it be done unto you. And now in Asia, the poppy fields that produce heroin, they're grinding out because they don't have no other product that they can get a high price for.

bananas, we can't even get the market, you're giving it to the big boys in Central America, you depress the price of sugar, you depress the price of bauxite, everything that come out of the Caribbean is way down low, so the Caribbean is suffering. Now listen to me, Africa's suffering now, but they decided, send the drugs to America. It's the richest country on earth, send the drugs to America. So from Asia, the Bekaa Valley, heroin coming. From Central and South America and the Caribbean, ganja, cocaine coming. All of it coming toward America. America say, stop the drugs! Lies, lies, baby! Oh no! If you can put a telescope in space, and when it messes up, you can correct the Hubble telescope to see way out there, planets and stars that are light years away, and you can't catch drugs?

I know, drugs, drugs is part of the program. It's part of the program for you. Want you to hear me, I'm almost finished. Those drugs, coming now, four hundred and thirty-eight billion dollars in the black community. It's a rich community. They're hopeless. Give them some drugs. Make them drug salesmen. Now they got you. No job. You selling ganja? You selling crack? You selling drugs? And you're protected. You put guns in your hand? Here, here, here's some guns. And this is your territory. And hey, hey, you, you, that leadership ability, here, take this. So now you're all killing each other.

You, young man, powerful. But look at you. Go to the funeral parlor, see who's dying. Grandma ain't dying today. Grandma taking her grandbabies to their final resting place. What's happening to you black men? You're too young, you're too fighting age, in the working age and ain't got no job for you, and the West. It's that Willie Lynch syndrome all over again. people dying and we're not being killed by white police. I know it's bad when a Canadian policeman will kill the black brother, and it's happening too frequently now. However, it's even worse on the weekends when you go to the hospitals and it's you putting your own self and your own people in these hospitals, killing each other like killing is going out of style. This is part of the plan, this is part of the conspiracy, and you are a willing accomplice in the conspiracy to destroy yourselves and to destroy one another.

Now look, not only must you kill each other, your birth rate must decline. Do you know what? They are putting so many hormones in the atmosphere, the environment. I read something recently where in the Everglades, the alligator's penis had begun to shrink. No, no, no, no, it's not funny. No, no, no, no, no, listen to me. I'm not trying to be faulter, and I'm not making jokes. I'm telling you something that you're experiencing and don't even know what the hell is going on. The penis of the alligator is shrinking, and the sperm count is way down, because they're introduced into the environment female hormones. They are attacking the regenerative or reproductive system in both the male and the female. Now check yourself.

The sperm count in the men is almost half of what it used to be. You don't intend for you to keep on reproducing. So between the birth control pill, the Nore plant, and the foods that you are ingesting, cervical cancer is more so now in black women than it ever has been, breast cancer and prostate cancer, the number one killer of black men over forty years of age. And even now, younger men find themselves impotent and don't even know why. part of the plan. I'm not trying to change you from being a Christian. All I want to do is inspire you to live up to the faith that you've been taught, and to understand that white supremacy must be discarded because it does not allow you the best effect in your worship. It must be removed so that you can come up free, not to be a servant of white people, but a servant of God.

I want you to hear me. They are afraid of anybody who will change your thinking, and that's why they attack me so hard. I'm not a bad man, but they know if you listen to me, your thinking is going to change. And because you have been so kind to come out in such strong numbers and to listen, now they say, oh God, all of them people listening to that man, well, it's time for you now to make a change in your life. My brother said, tell them to go back to Africa. Well, I want to tell you this. I want to tell you this. You know, the earth is the Lord's, and the fullness there are. Not just Africa, but every square inch of it belongs to God. And when you are God's people, there's no place on the earth that you should feel that you are a stranger. I want you to hear me. Listen. But, if Africa does not rise, you will always be down.

As long as Africa, the mother continent, is down and destroyed and nothing, you will never be respected in Canada. I will never be respected in America. And no black people will be respected anywhere on the earth. Africa must rise! Africa must rise. If you look at the Chinese, they used to have all kind of silly jokes about Chinese people. But China is a power now. And when you see Chinese people, I don't care where you see them, whether they agree with the Chinese philosophy, either on mainland China or Taiwan, both of those nations are up and moving, and their economies are some of the fastest growing in the world. And so, when you see the Chinese, you don't look at him now as just your laundry man. You got a little more respect for the Chinese. When you see Mexico rising, you have more respect for the Mexicans that live here. And when you see Japan rising, Japanese all over the world are respected. The fastest growing economies in the world are those in Asia. So you can't look at the little fella today and make mockery of him, you gotta respect him. But they have marginalized Africa. Africa must rise. If we are going to gain respect— Now I'm gonna tell you something, Canada. You may not like what I'm about to say. You may not like it. But look, there are more gifted Caribbean people outside of the Caribbean than in the Caribbean.

You have more gifted Africans outside of Africa than in Africa. I know, we all believe, you know, this is home. But there's an old saying in the Bible that in that day every man shall find refuge under his own vine and fig tree. So when the pressure starts coming, after you make your money in Canada. Look and see the Caribbean. Its land is there, its wealth is there, it only needs cultivation and development. Look at Africa. The land is there, the gold is there, the diamonds is there, all of us trying to get along, you know, with our former colonial master. But things getting tough, things getting rough. And now the brothers and sisters in Canada, those of you who've made some money, you say, well, I think, I think I want to go home.

left Guyana, they only have 750,000 or so people living there, but the land, rich, rich, rich, all it needs is cultivation. Suriname, all it needs is cultivation. The Caribbean, all it needs is cultivation. And what we need is political stability so that intellectuals can come and render their service, because the Caribbean in unity will have great, great power. And lastly, I will say that the blacks in America—see, it's written that Joseph became a master in the land where he was sold as a slave. I believe that's true, and I believe that we will never be free until we turn our talent and the best of our finances to develop economically here in America, in the Caribbean, and in Africa. So as I leave you, Toronto, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, no, don't, don't, don't run, because, you know what? Believe me, everybody's going to leave out of here just as peaceful and calm, and you're not going to lose nobody.

You don't have to run. I know I've kept you a long time. But, Toronto, you must not allow yourself to fall victim to the conspiracy and become a partner with those who seek your destruction. or Hebrew or Rasta. We are one family. Flesh of each other's flesh, blood of each other's blood, and bone of each other's bone. So when you see me, you're looking at your brother. When I see you, I'm looking at my brother and my sister. And when I know this is my family, then we should unite and embrace each other. And as we grow in maturity, starting first with yourself, then you've got to recognize that brotherhood is not in skin. Brotherhood is more than skin. Brotherhood has to be a spirit, and it has to deal with faith. And when people grow in faith in God, they will see each other as brother, but then wherever you see faith, no matter what the color is, you'll see a member of your spiritual family. But you cannot unite with others until you first unite among yourselves.

May God bless you as I greet you in peace. Assalamu alaikum. Are we on? I would warn everyone as we move along here to begin to be able to be flexible enough to be changing plans, to be flexible enough to accept new ideas, and to accept one another. It's a real error to come along the way and burn your bridges, and that includes you, John. Until you have stability in your own capability. I suggest you not burn bridges.

Lest you do have to sleep on the floor. And who's going to help get you up? I can get up. Want to bet? You're getting awful spunky. Ten-four. I can get up. No, that's not... There, sit down. See, on the way to twirl it.

It's out of a chair. And if you can do that right now, why don't you do it all the time? Because I've got to have an excuse. Ah, so. I think in the words of the baby, uh-oh. That's right. It's a very profitable day. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing.

I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing.

I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. I found a lot of clothes that were missing. Maybe 35 suits. Very good. But we've got to find them first. I want all of you to very seriously think with me for just a minute. I'm not going to give away any kind of information that can be painful or hurtful to any other involved.

So I'm not going to literally name names. But our colleagues in South Africa, and I want them to get these tapes of Ferechan or our tapes from today immediately by Federal Express some way that you can get them there shortly. I want them to hear this. They are working with a man of color. He is so high in the Muslim faith as to be called the Amir. He is one of the very closest friends of Lewis Perrican. We're going to turn this world around in an evolvement, re-volvement. I don't want to even have the connotation revolution. But the word revolution only means a turnabout. They hate Louis Ferracon for the same reason they hate me and they hate you. Because you've seen through their lies. You've caught them with their hands in the cookie jar. And you've had to spend a decade now struggling with this to learn, to learn, to learn, to learn. Your teachers are constantly busy. And then comes along Mr. Horn and he says, well, you can't have three bites out of the apple or two bites. I mean, they've already had. They've never had anything except bills and terror and whatever else they can dish out. And Gene finally did a brilliant piece of work and said, it is not the Edwards who have had more than one bite out of the apple.

They've never even touched the apple, while Mr. Horn has had three big hunks out of the apple. Well, he's going to choke on one of them, because he's dragged this out so long that the one who went out of business But I think that Rick ought to really just, Rick I think you ought to bind it and sell it. I think you ought to read the transcript of Bogart's program and then I would ask, with charges against Bogreitz and George Green then. But you see, there are so many outstanding things. What about Methvin, who at urgings of Mr. Green and so forth, stripped Acker's bank account last Christmas and still on the first of each month, sends him an updated bill with compound interest.

Why don't you do something? Well, there's also Rod Hentz, who took all the equipment and money. There's a limitation to how much we can do and how long we can continue to do this and survive. It's more than a full-time job for a dozen people. And so you do what you can, as you can, and we just keep moving forward. it to happen. These things are not right. They are not right. And I know it must have just blown Horn's mind to sit across from E.J. and he wants to know, well, what are you doing going on through this?

And E.J. said, because it's wrong. George Green's attorney asked Rick, well, what do you want out of this? And Rick said, I want justice. I want truth. This is wrong. And until you can rectify things simply because they are wrong, you can't make it. Because you will settle for less, you will settle for the lie, you will settle for the wars, you will settle for these cheap, nasty, rotten, mean individuals. unfolding in front of you and I can't even see why you are not quivering, shaking. You are so close to total destruction of a world system.

There is one person second in line, and maybe Rick would like to share that with us, to Mr. Bush, and that is Madeleine Albright, your Ambassador to the United Nations, now going to be your Secretary of State. It is disgusting. This woman comes right out of the same cult as George Bush, and it is just as evil. Ask Kathy and Mark to elaborate on this woman who insults the female of the species. You're being set up for the bump-off people. I wrote a little earlier about some of the things planned. You see, you don't know how many times you almost got it. You can talk about little bits of plutonium on a Russian missile going to Mars. Oh no, those warheads were made of red mercury.

And they were trying to get that rocket into an orbit.
