00:01

[Hatonn] Are you willing to do something with the tape? 

[EJ] We are ready, sir.  This is the 24th of April, 1999. Greetings, Commander. 

[Hatonn] Good afternoon. Do you want the song and dance, the chapter and verse?  What do you want from me?  I come in radiance.  I've never been anywhere else, and yet we've been everywhere, haven't we?  I've never moved away from a single one of you, and I've had such pain as I've watched some of you struggling.  Not for your direction, you know what your direction is, but in the give and take of living, in the time of making a transition, all of you have had to pay the price of the more misdirected ones.  We don't give them a load upon which to chew, but I told you before this journey started last August, that there would be sorting.  That when we began to move into our real, True, forward-moving mission, we'd have to have our place in order.

And we're there.  We're there.  And these last throes of what you're going to call pain, flak, confrontation are of no consequence.  People, always, always with God have a right to make their own choices, their own decisions.  And you in your human form, with your human built-in ego..., and if you have managed to put the ego down, then it's even more difficult for you to understand. Because egos clash, and I'm going to talk about egos here for a minute, because they are the undoing of all human individuals. 

It's very difficult to come along, and finally have a little success.  You want to pound your chest, or beat your head, or something, and say, well, somebody look, we're doing it. It's fine as long as you say we're doing it. When you say, look what I did, I am now king of the hill, everybody bow, and scrape, you're in serious, serious trouble.  Especially with such a massive program as we will have. Everybody has always been told that.  Every individual coming to this place has been told that. Every individual coming to this place has also realized that funding is imminent. That's my favorite word, ‘imminent’.  Because the ego snatches ‘imminent’, and goes to work on you, according to what it wants to accomplish. 

Bruce, I'm going to add another book. Any of you who have now finished Dyer's book, that you should have, need the next one, Your Sacred Self.  I don't have time to go through, and give these lessons individually, but maybe somebody can call Dwayne, and ask him if we might run some of his things, in series, in our paper.  It will be the favored topic that ones will search for, although you're going to have plenty to feast upon.

It takes you another step beyond, and into the integrated aspect of self, and your higher dimension, and how to function in your human world while you're trying to come to some grips with this thing within self, called ego.  It simply is the part of you that does not want you to be spiritual, because it is the part of you that feeds on fear.  And once you are no longer fearful, especially of a passage, or an ascension, or a change, a translation.  The ego will do exactly what it did with Rick, exactly what it did with Charles. These people know what to do. But did you watch it truly unfolding with Ed Young?

Isn't this frightening?  And most missed it.  “Oh look, our PhD now has taken”... Hatonn who has said, “I am going to bestow upon you, son, all authority”.  Do you really think so?  Look how many are missing.  Somebody thought so, and now doesn't it come forth?   This is the next thing you will hear, the argument on behalf of Rick, and Ed, and what they're doing.  Well, you're never going to do it, and you promised us, Commander, so you can't be the same Commander.

Why can't I be the same Commander?  I've told you it's ‘imminent’ for twelve years.  Why do you think that suddenly Commander would leave?  Especially with a team overseas?  It's hardly the place to go to relax. You know, it's ninety degrees raining.  It's ninety degrees at three in the morning.  Ninety five to a hundred degrees right now, raining.  And when you have rain like they have there, where the sky opens, they call it monsoon, El Niño, La Niña... everything got blamed on El Niño, and La Niña.  And now the rains have started in the spring, so it must be La Niña still, the little girl, retaliating against the little boy.

Can't we stop retaliation, and become HUman, as in a higher universal intelligence?  Or you're gonna go down.   And what I did promise you, many years ago, is if you stay with us, you’re not gonna save anything, you are going to change the world.  Because we're going to do it now through the people.  We the people.  

We've played with heads of state.  We have such a massive program working, as I speak, in the ASEAN Conference, the ASEAN, A-S-E-A-N, not ASIAN, although it would do, except this is the ASEAN Conference, and this will pull in all the Asian nations, with the exception of the Philippines, and these are mostly Muslim, Buddhist.  They are a conglomeration of many of those religions over in Malaysia, and Indonesia, but there is so much hard metal stashed over there.  That was the place to go, and bury the gold.  Now why would that be good?

Well, because that was a place where the United States of America could haul off your gold, and stash it over there along with the Japanese gold, and then it could be cleaned through Marcos, and sent to Singapore, Taiwan, Hong Kong, all around, to make it circulation into the Khazarian banks, of course in Switzerland, Munich, Germany, all over Europe where you find the Khazarians.  Has anybody noticed how much stronger the Khazarian Empire has become in the United States?  Well, we are working in Asia with some of the bankers, and the ones that... well you've seen, you've seen the one on the rich and famous, that is basically organizing the ASEAN circumstance, because this one was willing to put up 80, no, 20 percent of their entire gold wealth.

You see, everybody wants to talk about..., Rick especially, wants to talk about the Global Alliance.  Instruments.  Those instruments are only for a security four, five, six, ten years out.  Now, when you talk about things, you don't even, that is not the big issue.  In the Philippines you cannot have gold. You can have jewelry, but you may not have gold in the banks.  They won't...you can't just go to a bank, and sell your gold, and let's put it right down where it is.  You might have somebody living on the Possig River, with all assets basically tied up, frozen in some of the land grabs that took place for the government.  But they may literally have a bar of gold in their pillow.  Or they may...over there, you don't have nice block springs, and a nice mattress.  You have a ply board base, and they put a mattress on it.  And if you're lucky, you have springs.  And this is in the hotels. 

10:53

Now of course, the magnificent Oriental, and American hotels, that still charge an arm, leg, and your head.  And nobody from the Philippines can afford to even be in there, unless they're one of these that have been able to somehow sell offshore, their gold.  Well, they don't want to get rid of this little tool that they have in Manila, where the capital of the Philippines is.  They want to be able to control every bar of gold, every piece of gold coinage in that central bank.  Well, you see, they also have about, well, maybe second to the United States, corrupt government. 

They know it.  They dwell in corruption, and cronyism.  They have a better system for cleaning up your streets as far as crooks are concerned than anybody.   The police watch the US movies, and television, and if they find a gang of people dealing in drugs, or illicit trade of some kind, they get in for a cut, the police.  And then, if they are cut out of the cut, they just ‘salvage’ everybody.  That just, that means you just line ‘em up, and shoot ‘em.  And surely enough, oh well, we can't allow the salvaging.  So they bring the people in who did the salvaging, and in this one incident, one didn't die.  Then they put him in the hospital, and he’s going to survive to testify.  Well the police just came into the hospital, in their uniforms, and walked to his room and shot him.  That's called ‘re-salvaging’, I suppose.  Recycling, maybe. 

So the circumstances of turning around a global circumstance, hopefully prior to the total outbreak of atomic, nuclear war over what you have going over there now.  You're already into Armageddon, hadn't anybody noticed?  How many other nations do you hear talked about, other than the U.S.?  And who else do you see running around over there but little Maddy Albright, Cohen, and the other Jewish rulers.  Now, how much do you think they're going to let you get away with, in the United States?  Surprisingly enough, they're going to let you get away with a lot.  If you don't break them.

They're between rocks, and hard places, too.  And when you hear, oh, ‘imminent collapse’, imminent collapse of your monetary system.  I want to tell you BS.  They will collapse it when it is appropriate, and handy for them.  Under the circumstances upon which they work, they can print money from here until... they can build more presses, and more presses, and they will shore up whatever they want to tell you.  And here you're over 10,000 on your ridiculous stock market?  You're talking about a small little handful of gamblers doing exactly what they want to do.  It means absolutely nothing.  And everybody hangs on it from one part of the globe to another, and then for another nice little added distraction to you, the people of the United States of America, somebody goes in, and shoots a bunch of school children.

And then the world stops for a day.  So that internationally, that takes every bit of attention.  These people were told - “don't go back there, don't go back to the United States”.  And that may be why Rick and Charles are saying they won't come home.  Oh no.  These people are secure.  They ceased being secure.  They really pushed the river.  And they really pushed my patience.  And if it had not been for a plane load of innocent people, I don't think I would have interfered.

But you would have had a major, major international incident.  And we're not here to have international incidents.  We're not here to save anything.  If they want to save the Philippines, the Filipinos are going to do it!  But we will show them the way, and then they will come together, and they will do exactly what they're doing.  They are friends of, relations with, the Marcos regime, and the government's always trying to deal with Imelda.  

Now this is one of the most incredibly interesting women you will ever meet, if you ever have the opportunity, and don't hold your breath, because you will.  The lady is shrewd, and she just sits there, and the tears pour down her face, and she says, “I've lost all of my friends”. Well, maybe she's lost the friends in high places, because you're going to find out why I have been so hard on you with corporate structure.  

They are absolutely the shrewdest people you will ever meet with the handling of corporations, foundations, and so forth.  And guess who taught them?  Your own people.  Mr. Bush, Mr. Baker.  And Russell Herman...  Rusty.  That was his playground.  They all know Rusty Herman. He worked with Marcos. He trained the security, and intelligence people for Marcos.  He structured, and set up the security of this global bomb, and now the ones under Marcos, who had power under Marcos, are creeping out.  But let's look at what happened, and this is why you have to be careful, and this is why you want to do the sorting before you begin. 

18:14

To really make this work, you have to have a coalition of trustworthy friends.  It doesn't really matter, it's just handier.  And before Marcos died, as he began to get more, and more ill, he set up entire serieses... entire series?  Oh, you're English.  He set up many foundations, and he called them ‘umbrella’ foundations.  And he set it up where a lot of his gold would go, say, to Long Beach, a lot of it would go to San Diego, a lot of it went to Libya, tons and tons of it went to Iraq, all over, Singapore, all over...and he was able to hook up with a head of state, or someone very powerful there, and he would send one of his henchmen over, and they would do a corporate structuring.

And anybody could sign on this, but he would have...before they could dissolve the corporation, there would have to be at least two signatures.  Now let's just take Libya.  I'm using that as an example, because it's changed in Libya, but this is the way it was.  There would be Gaddafi, and a Marcos person, a thug, and maybe a son of Gaddafi.  And they would be the ones.  So it would mean that at any time you wanted to change the structure of this umbrella foundation, or corporation, you had to have at least three of those signatures on the document, or a valid reason showing that, as in the case of some of them...this General Barr, there, who just died, well, in the last six months...  Then you can have someone that would be set up, or structured in the pecking order, to take their place.  

Well, they're very practical about their nastiness.  “I may like you very much, but you are expendable, always for the larger cause, which is myself, you're expendable”.  On the other hand, you are going to find that Marcos liked his role of daddy...father.  He wanted to take care of his Philippine children.  He wanted to build a society structured on the proper foundation of wealth, so that the currency had value.  Well, obviously, there came the time that the United States did not want that to happen, and so he gets deposed.  They called it a ‘bloodless coup’.  

They had a revolution.  They’re going to have another one, and that's the second time I'll pull the people out.  On June 17th, they are going to have a major, major celebration of Risalde.  That's a national hero, and they fully intend to begin to put the pressure on.  They don't have to...kill anybody.  I guess they may do it, but they don’t have to.  They play in a game, and the people are getting sick, and tired of being dirt poor.  And they don't see any reason for this, and they don't see any reason for the famine, because the United States won't finish shipping a shipload of grain.

It bogs down in Taiwan, and meanwhile, the rice paddies are filled with what they call ‘giant worms’.  These are such large earthworms, digesting, literally digesting, the berms that hold the water in the rice fields.  And these paddies go all the way to the top of the mountains.  Remember, there's volcano landscape.  

That's where it is going to make its most remarkable change, and that's why I told you years, and years ago, when RJ would sit in here... everybody's looking for the gold, everybody's looking for this, and everybody wants their hands on that...  An awful lot of that gold is still in the ground there, and there is a lot of interest in building a free society there.  And the Pleiadians are there.  And that's what we're going to do, and you will find it very interesting. 

You have the tiniest little people there.  The little girls look like little girls, and they never age. They never age. You know, a 13-year-old child looks like a 49 year old woman, same little size, and yet their little babies grow rapidly, and they're chubby, and you think how in the world can this mother have had that baby, and she's still carrying it around now in her arms?  They love their children.  The malls are filled with the children, but there's a reason for that too.  You can't breathe the air, and live outside.  So you go to the mall, and that is the outing for these families.  They go, and trot through the mall, and this is geared for families.  They have giant playgrounds right in the middle of the mall, inside.

So they know where they're going, if they can be allowed to get there, but all the time...and a good example... they managed to get money for two atomic power production plants.  They managed to get less than one out of all the money that went to do that, so the laughter always is - “oh, well, we got one for the price of two”.  

So back to your foundations, and your cronyism, and your practice of good business.  Marcos handed over oodles, and boodles of stock, for instance, to his little friend, that he had literally gotten on his feet, got him started.  His name is Lucio Tan, one of the Saipans.  That's not right, Taipans.  You know, written up everywhere.  Major owner of PAL Airlines, that is until you guys came along, and were still dinkering around with PAL Airlines.  That was one of the last questions asked of these people before they left, now, do you want me to pursue PAL Airlines?  Which has gotten to be laughable, because you go to the mall, you go anywhere, and they, you know, some of these people come right up, and hug EJ.

The White Knights of Philippine Airlines, and it's on this week, it's off next.  Lucio Tan will put up another 200 million dollars to hold it another little while.  He doesn't really want it to go.  All of that was Marcos.  Philippine long distance telephone.  Marcos.  So Imelda gets mad, and she comes out, and she says, I'm going to sue all these guys who took all the stock, and they were supposed to give it back because there was a bargain. And now that I'm in trouble, and Marcos, and Ferdinand's dead, I'm going to sue these people.  Get my stock back. 

So the Supreme Court meets and, you know, it just, it just churns.  So they have this poor little Imelda in before the Supreme Court, and she's weeping, and she's doing all the things.  This lady is a better actress than Sarah Bernhard ever was.  And so she does her thing, and she gets...you know, and then the next thing you see is her with President Estrada at somebody's wedding.  You can't figure out what it is.  Nobody tells you the Truth.  

It is...uh..you open a Philippine mouth, and they won't give you any bad news.  You know, I, what do you have in your hand?  Oh, well, what was it you wanted?  Oh, that's what I have in my hand.  Well, let me see it. Oh, well, um, I just stashed it over here with Joe.  Well, you're watching.  They don't want to give you bad news, and if they're working on something that they hope that they can make work, they'll tell you it's working.  

28:06

[EJ something unintelligible] .... Dr. Bart.  

[Hatonn] Well, we're glad to have Dr. Bart, because we're going to have a clinic.  We're going to get on with a lot of the stuff, and you may think that you have a very, very tiny little crew.  No, now you have a crew.  That's the difference.  One of the major problems that we had with things going the way they were going with the newspaper, was exactly what you were being accused of... changing the locks...changing locks in the door in the dark, and that somehow makes you bad.  No, it took all day to get the paperwork to legally change those locks.

I'm sorry, everybody who would think it otherwise, and all you need from God is a bunch of pious BS.  God expects more from you, than that attitude.  And it has never been told to you differently, not from this being.  And you cannot go into the throes of battle in a mission, because you can't go with guns, and swords, or arrows, or rocks.  You've got to do it right.  You've got to do it appropriately, correctly, and you have to do it righteously.  And when you have habits that form where everyone has to meet your needs, that's ego.  And when your entire life experience functions through the night, when you’re not a shift worker, you have bad things taking place.

So the next question always is - why did you let it go so far, sir?  Why are you hitting me this hard? This would be Dharma.  How could you let me end up in Southeast Asia, with people who would do what they've done since they left there.  And I said, because you're going to be hurt some more.  You're going to find it bitter, and this was one of the most incredibly difficult mornings we had to get through, was when I called a meeting.  I had to push it, push it, push it right up to the edge.

And I said, get them to this room now.  I want a meeting.  There are things going on.  You don't know what they are, and these people had changed their reservations, had even told our contact, our business contact, that they had changed their reservations to come home.  Rick thought he could get home, and cover his antics.  So I think I'm going to get right down to hard metal, right now.  

You're going to find, and this is always a blow..., Dharma just says, “I couldn't, no, no, no, no, sir”.  It would not be that way.  You're going to find that the Bobsy Trio wrote themselves some bonus checks, and so forth, within the last month.  Rick had to get home, because this was gonna break, and that's compliments of Miss Gail, and Dr. Ed.  Well, I didn't notice them paying Princeton, or Al, or Margie, or... they gave themselves, personally, bonuses out of your money.

[EJ] Ed, Gail & Rick

[Diane] Was that, after they were locked out?  

[Hatonn] Along about the same time. They still have the check book.  

[Diane] Do you want me to share the date that they wrote that check?  

[Hatonn] Share it, Diane. We're here to share. This is...

[Diane] The checks were written the 9th of March.  

[Unknown person] Oh.  

[Diane] And what happened on the 10th of March?  Supposed to have happened.  That was the day, the 10th, is when the letter came to Ed that he was to be fired.  

[Unknown person] yeah, yeah

[Diane]  Those checks were supposedly written on the 9th.  Now they may have back-dated them. Anyway, Gail may have... is that working?  Okay.  Gail may have written a date back on those checks, but the original checks were dated on the 9th of March. They're bonus checks. 

[Unknown person] Bonus checks?

[Diane] It was not written on the checks; ‘bonus check’, but it was an amount that was undue to the corporations involved. 

[Unknown person] Is that how they got all the donated money out?

[Hatonn] Well, they were trying. They didn't get it all out. 

[Diane] They didn’t get it all out, but I also believe that they knew that, in my opinion, that things were not going the way they wanted them to go, and knew something was going down, which is why, in my opinion, fourteen pages was dedicated to how to plant a garden.  

[Unknown person]  To use the money..

[Diane] To dump the money.  If they couldn't have it, no one will have it. 

[Hatonn] Well, I will tell you the most disappointing thing. When revenge enters the picture, or fear of being cut out some way enters the picture, what Gail, and Rick did, I believe that you may find very close to unforgivable.  It was actually playing right into my hands, so don't expect old dad to feel bad.  You have to sometimes bait the trap to catch the rats. 

35:28

Back to the parties that I told you... heads of state, so wealthy that at one time this one man was considered the wealthiest one human being on your globe.  And he's still a very big shot head of state.  Gail called the embassy to get numbers, etc., and these children think they're playing with their little school blocks.  They are playing with people who have armies!, private armies...just to get rid of their problems.  And the person that we were working with is the head of one of their private armies!  Nice guy.  And he's up, and over his head into this thing, working with these guys, with ‘The Brothers’.  We call them The Brothers.  And they're going to put up 20% of all their assets to back what we're doing.  And they get a fax from Rick Martin, unsigned, that says these people are not authorized to do business. 

It is amazing, except that they are now rendered so useless, that they're alive.  They were going to send the assassins, after the deal was made to not blow up the plane!  Do you hear me!?  Does everybody in this room hear me? 

[Diane] Yes.  Absolutely. 

[Hatonn] We've talked about it for twelve years. You've written about it.  The man comes over... there's all this little talk about Enemy of the State, a motion picture.   And there is even talk, “hey man, that's nothing”, and they consider you enemies of the state.  We had a person come over from Dubai, in NATO, and said, “you are classified as economic terrorists”.   Oh, hee, hee, hee, hee.

They have said to me, Hatonn.... remember, I met with them.  Not with this lady.  I met with them with her, I met with them without her.  They don't have any trouble with me.  Just Rick and Charles, I suppose, and they said, “get ‘em out of here, Rick is like a chatterbox”.  They had cameras, they had surveillance tapes.  Every move was watched, every time they left the hotel, they were followed.  And I'll tell you how good they are, these surveillance guys.  Rick and Charles would look around a room, and they would locate these ‘CIA agents’.  Hell, those were just gold dealers.  You bet they were always there, they’re just gold dealers.  

So the word came down, “you get those two out of town, or we're going to take ‘em all out”.  Well why would you pick on Charles if he wasn't doing the talking?  Because he's always with Rick, and that's the way it is.  And then they were going to send their hit team all the way over to the United States, because they don't cotton well to multi-hundreds of billions of dollars being just wiped over here into the hole slot.  And a whole ASEAN conference to be bent for peace, and I don't expect you to comprehend it.  Dharma can't.  EJ can't.  And obviously Rick and Charles can't.  

And they gave me an ultimatum.  And I don't cotton to ultimatums, but they made one I didn't want to refuse, and that was get them out of there.  And that's when they really got mad, because they didn't... there was no privacy for EJ, and Dharma.  If they didn't want to send the email, they didn't.  They dumped it.  The email, and the letters, and things that were coming over here stopped being circulated at all, and Ed dumped it.  So you didn't have very much Commander for at least eight months.  I let them go.

And a lot of you need to know what happened, because this seems to be the theme running through most of the objections of people out there, scattered around, readers.  We're supposed to be a non-bigoted organization, right?  Well, let me tell you what happened about that.  

The demand was, on my part, these notices had to be run in that paper, because that was the instrument used for communication.  When I would agree to something, “that's fine, sir, you just write that in the next CONTACT.  You run those notices, and that way we now have a give, and take communication system”. 

Now what did Ed Young do?  He started putting my Hatonn writings, and things like that on the back of the page with the notice.  Well, I might be sitting in the room, myself, personally, in a physical form, when they get that paper.  What is this?  What kind of a cult rag is this?  You know, we're Muslims, and the Muslims are the opposite side of Armageddon.  We don't want to be hooked up with Bin Laden, who's running around somewhere in the Philippines, and over in Pakistan.

Tape ended abruptly at 42:50

tapes.text:
990424-1b

6-9-24
Paul

NOTES FROM THE PHILIPPINES, WORKING WITH THE EXTENDED MARCOS FAMILY, MONEY ON THE WAY, LIVE IN THE NOW, AND LET THE PAST GO

[Hatonn] What is this?  Just be patient. We will ask that they not do that. You know that that's not me, I'm here with you.  Then what is this cleaning house bit?  Are the people that we're dealing with going to be cleaned out?  What are they going to do with your speaker, and your receiver? Says, here, they're going to get rid of them.  So, just a little bit of indigestion.

No, we're not going to get rid of anybody, except them.  So the first contact was, with EJ to Ed, please do not run any more of these writings with no identification, nothing on them, until we finish, until, we didn't shut ‘em down, until we have finished running these public notices.  And then, by golly, gee whiz, I want identification of those receivers.  I even gave them names.  Joseph will recognize this.  

So I want to introduce you to one who has grown up.  And I want to tell you that the writing that swung these guys around, was the one on war, by Zoanor... Joseph, and he's right here.  It's games playing, it’s ego in operation.  So, were we upset?  No, and when these people left, we just had our young man, who has his little army, going to Europe, to get us some interim funding.  It should have been transferred already.  Well, then there are other issues that came up.  Other countries wanted to get into the program.  So could we just hold it?

Well, how long did you want to hold it?  Well, we'll need some contracts, and we'll need some paperwork.  Well, but we can't divulge names, and we...for security, we can't do this, and we can't do that.  How can we work it out?  So we finally get a system worked out, and it just gets too complicated back here.  And when on schedule, the man made the trip to London, funds in a major size were to be transferred in an interim fund, to get covered with gold immediately, and part of it would flow here, to catch everything up.  Just catch everything up, until we could breathe.  

Well, that bogged down.  They had all their documentation done, in order, and it will break loose. But now comes the Bobsy Bunch, sending these newspapers over to the guy.  Fifteen of ‘em show up in his post office in Davao.  This is in Mindanao, the southern large island.  And it's almost all Muslim.  And its governor is Muslim, and his name is Mizwary, and they don't think this is funny.  And then they send all their little flyer sheets to him.  And that's not funny.  And then somebody sends a letter bomb that blows up the Davao post office.  

Well now, what would you think if you were them, and they had been watching this fanatic crap come in that post office?  And if the team upon which we're going to build a structure is no brighter than to do these stupid, silly, childish little games that will get someone else killed, is what we have with which to work….I'm not gonna work, and you're to the crossroads.  And before we have a little break, I want to lay another one on you that's good news.  And this is why I want you to get that next book by Dyer, because I want you to begin to associate every non-coincidence that happens to you.  And when you finally turn it over to God, and say, “Sir, I don't understand this all.  I'm putting it in your hands, and I'm going to release it to you, but I'm going to do everything that I can to help”.  

You will watch it happen.  And the heart is so tight...Sir we’re leaving, we have not had our man back yet from London, the visa’s expiring, all the things, and I’m saying, go home.  Let us tend our business at home. They need to gain the strength of the...oh, God, EJ, you've got to be there.  I mean, these are the Hong Kong bankers coming over to meet with you….Guess what, today.  No, they can call you today if they have to.  We are going home to get our house a little bit in order, and our people a little bit more comfortable.  

So EJ, and Dharma were doing business with someone, oh, twenty years ago.  All of you have heard of Bill Cudd, for instance.  Well, most of you have heard of John Jeffers.  Audrey, and Eric have heard of John Jeffers, because Audrey invested some money in helping him.  I'm not going to divulge amounts right now.  I want you to keep in mind, however, that one of the major thrusts... and we have bunches of money on the table...If I told you how much... if I just said, E.J., how much is processing?  You wouldn't believe ‘im.  It's so huge.  And of course, these people have gotten pretty casual about saying, “well, I will believe it when it shows up.  I'll do everything I'm supposed to do. I'll go meet, I'll do whatever I'm supposed to do, but it's too overwhelming. I just will accept it as it rolls”.   

8:00

And now it is rolling through Bong Bong...Now, I don't want you to think I've lost my marbles.  These are the names they give their people.  The son of Imelda, and Ferdinand's, name, is Bong Bong.  There’s one called Bing Bing, and then there is a Bing Bong.  Now, they're in different families, and pretty soon you sing ding-a-ling-dong-dong.  And then there is Tony Boy.  Well, that goes with Eddie Joe, so they go along really good.  But then comes to the meeting somebody call Tony Boy, and he's an attorney, and he comes in, and nobody knows who these people are talking to.

Hi Tony! And he... that's it...Huh?  Well isn’t your name Tony?  No...  Victor, you said his name was Tony.  He said... No, I said Tony Boy.  Okay?  Tony Boy [said fast]...Attorney Boy [enunciated more clearly].  

[Audience] Oh, gosh.  Oh, gosh.  

[Hatonn] He's an attorney.  So, doesn't ‘Torney Boy (said very fast) sound like Tony Boy to you?  Well, to them it's a ‘Torney Boy.  So, we started calling everybody Tony.  Tony Jay, you know.  Tony Marge.  So it's the new label.  What is your name?  Tony.  Except when it's Bong Bong.  

Well, there is another story to briefly tell you.  Before Ferdinand met Imelda, and fell in love with her, she was, I don't know about all this love bit, but she was the Queen of Manila.  You know, she was the Rose Queen, or something.  Beauty pageant.  And he meets her, and so in a very short period of time they decide to get married, but that dispossessed his mistress, and three children.  So before Bong Bong, there were other, older children.  Now they take care of one another.  They don't seem to object to this relationship.  Guess who Jeffers is working with?  Anyone want to just guess how crazy this gets? 

[Audience guessing]  Bing Bong?  Bong Bong.  

[Hatonn] The first Big Bong.  His mistress' son, who now probably lives all over, but is basically working out of New York.  And you should have some money, by certainly the end of the week, or very early next.  Money is changing hands, changing banks.  As we speak, the talents are just feverishly working.  When we talked with Jeffers last night, his first major thrust, Audrey, is to get cleaned up what he owes with interest to Ekkers, and to Audrey, and it will be flowing.  

He thought the major ones that have to be paid to keep the business rolling should be the first, but you should be getting some word by the end of the week, possibly transfers.  It will be bank to bank wires so that it won’t have to clear.  And that will be enough to keep you going very nicely, until we can sort out, and get the other going.  Everything is going to have to be done offshore.  This seems to be a problem for some. 

No.  The U.S. wants it done offshore. They will even work with us, if you don't come in, and collapse the economy of the United States.  And they have already made their arrangements as to how much they would allow to be funded at any one given point.  How long it would be before there would be a major confrontation over any of this, and I'm talking IMF, World Bank, and the Fed.  But they don't want this kind of massive stuff coming over here, or being introduced into the U.S.  That makes it better for us, because as we gain a little bit of funding, we can go ahead, and get the proper procedures started, and then we can start funneling money from offshore on to offshore native banks. 

So all the while you thought old Hatonn was just lollygagging around, we truly have been getting things in order, and the question always comes - but we're so poor right now, and the price of gold is down….yes, I've had to really keep it down, haven't I?  You're going to be in a position to be buying, and they're going to give you some bigger discounts.  

You can make it another week or two.  You see, fear, and it doesn't mean you shouldn't have anxiety or concern, but fear immobilizes.  Fear makes you do foolish things, and I'm not going to have liars, cheats, and thieves among the top teammates.  And when we get down the road a little bit further, you'll understand how much more important it was, or is, to have what happened, happened.

What are you going to do when there are billions of dollars to steal? Are these the kind of people you want running a system?  

[Audience] No, no

No.  You've got to have mature thought.  You've got to get rid of the lollygagging, oh God, and yet, that connection between you and God is your path.  But don't lie to God.  And that's what's happening.  You're not only lying about, you're lying to, and then you're calling it a game, and you're trying to cover it up.  And when the facts are out there, and the light is on it, this is what you end up getting.

16:15

You have nations to build. Bart thinks he goes, and tends the little Indian children...you've got to build a medical network, and we've got all the team we need, just remember that.  And we can find people to fill in all the rest.  You can hire people, and it's a lot less complicated, isn't it?   A lot less heartbreaking than when you've held, and handed your soul to someone to hold.  And maybe the next cup of milk the little Kosovo child gets, is because you saw to it.  Because God must be there too.  But it's going to be you that must do it, not fantasy land, not fantasy land.  Every one of you receives some...you listen a little better.

And then there are directed mission programs for information, for communication, and you don't know everything.  You just don’t know everything, but you're over the hurdle.  It's over.  It's done.  We only have to bring it into the useful fruit to eat, and we've got to do it without the fungus, we’ve got to do it without the leeches.  And you will always have some parasites, so you've got to take care, but we went from a program that now….it has been so tampered with, that it’s unworkable, but we’re going to tie it up in knots so nobody else is going to do it either.

We are going to protect Russell Herman.  They have his wills.  If you knew all of the things, you would shudder.  The role, maybe, that V. K. Durham played, or thought she was playing.  All of this is some exciting James Bond type stuff, but Russell Herman was real, and when he realized that his soul was going to bear some very heavy burdens, he started making arrangements, and they’re going to pay off now. In humanity. 

Let's have a break, please. 

[EJ] Ok

19:25

[Hatonn]  Thank you

[EJ] Thank you

[Hatonn] It seems like so much time, and it seems like no time, and that's where, that's where you've arrived.  Only in the now, and progressively you have now.  One of the hardest things that human creature has to face, and upon which you have to contend all the time, is measuring your now, by what was.  And you can't just let it go, you can’t say, oh, well, I will wipe all of that from my past, because you have to let go of the past.  And you must stop judging, and basing relationships... especially relationships, on any other interrelationship you had prior to now.  And for all of you trying to struggle through a world in chaos, and keep chaos out of your relationships, well, it just becomes impossible.  So, one of the impossibles to turn into possibility, is learning to let go of everything in the past, except the lessons you learned.  

Don't bring them up to beat each other over the head.  Don't continually, well...you did this, you did that.  No, that was your first wife, or your first husband.  Let it go.  And even if it was this one, let it go.  Every day now, you must build upon a good, and substantial, and sturdy foundation, because everybody is going to be taking pot shots at you.  That isn't because you represent one thing, and they represent another. It is because you are in a world of confrontation, and if I'm miserable, I'm going to see to it that you're miserable.  And you live a lie.  

It would be like a relationship between Gail and Rick.  What kind of a relationship could they possibly have, based on lies and manipulation?  And we always work from that which we deserve. Only, you don't even know what you are, so how do you know what you deserve?  So you will always treat your life experience the way you think you deserve.  And you will always reflect off the other one, that exact thing over which you, and your own individual personal self perceives them to be doing.  It may vary a little bit.  Dharma can't see, EJ can't hear, so, my word, you have a whole chasm in here to blame.

She can say to him, well, you didn't tell me, and I don't have anything wrong with my hearing.  Let it go.  Let it go.  Let's grow up, and move on.  All of the wonderful experiences are in the now, and what you perceive may be able to come in the future.  But you have to prepare just in case there is a future, because if you're prepared, you're going to make it.  And once you can grow outside the me-ness, where everything in your existence...because you are involved... you have to consciously let go of it.  It won't go away on its own, and that's why I want all of you to read on past, and into the experience of the sacred self.  Because these are the things upon which you must build what we must have, and you expend so much energy being mad, being blameful.

24:35

This is what I really feel sad about, with whatever rifts you have, is this incredible game of blame. It's your fault I did it. It's your fault I got so strung out. And how do I know whether she is receiving from a false god or not?  Do you realize it doesn't matter if she is?  It's your responsibility to take Truth, and build upon it.  Truth.  There's only one overall magnificent Truth about being.  But everyone, everyone, every individual has its own Truth.  Everything is Truth.  The story you may tell is a lie, and it may or may not be Truth to the one telling it.

There is one concept of God, but there are as many ways to make it there as there are individuals.  Men and women function differently, and I know that that is the bane of all existence.  It is also the glory of all existence.   Because each bounces off the other each requires that the other listen, even if it's ungraciously.  And how many quarrels have all of you had, and years later you remember the magnificent quarrel you had, if you could only remember what it was about. So what did you learn? Well, you learned that the memory's short, and that venom can really pour when the disposition's up.

Part of the shocker is that when the blame starts flowing, you find out what they thought of you all along.  And then even they will deny that.  Oh, well, I didn't really mean it.  I'd had too much to drink, or I was whatever.  Let's blame something else outside ourselves.  Why not just take responsibility, and you don't have to blame anybody?  And then you know the ones who say, oh, well, I did it.  I do it every time.  I'm the one to blame.

Well, that's a bunch of BS, isn't it?  So you know you've got another game going, and it's called the game of, look how hard I tried.  The games people play.  Well, most people don't have anything better to do with their time.  If abuse of substance, or alcohol, or whatever is going to flow into your now existence, get ready to get rid of it, because we're going to.  You've got to begin to function now, on the responsibility of self.  Too much rests on what kind of a foundation we lay, and you can know that everything you do is either a distraction, or a contribution toward something.

So all of these mischievous little egotistical naggings at you, you really do want to cast aside, because they're an annoyance.  It isn't that you don't have time for them, because you will always take time to do whatever it is you want to do.  But consciously try to begin to give these things up, for the bugaboos they are.  Is it really worth this argument, or this nagging, or this fight, or this confrontation going on, when I know I'm not going to get along the rest of the day?  I know I'm not going to get along for the rest of the week, and if I keep doing this, maybe I'll have to go through a divorce, which is a bigger distraction.  

Or I'll have to put the kids in a foster home, which is even a bigger one, because the government will still make you go see them.  And they'll even charge you for the foster home care, after they take them away from you.  Isn't it easier just to get along in the beginning?  But can't you evaluate the growth of people by what they do?  Blame Hatonn.  Blame the Ekkers.  Blame anyone you want to for your own foolishness, but it only makes you look more foolish, because especially with the Ekkers, we've had a lot of fun with this one.  

How could you be doing so very much wrong to get blamed for everything, and you've been gone for nine months?  Long enough to have a baby, with no control over it.  So you know how viable you are, and how wonderful you are, by what they're trying to do to you.  So we can be cutesy, you know, like Flip Wilson, and Red Skelton and, oh, “the devil made me do it”.  Well, of course the devil made you do it, but God kinda nudges the devil along a little bit.

And when you've really blundered, and locked yourself out of the door, have you ever noticed how the blame changes to something else, and you even get in deeper?  We're going to have to begin to clean those things up, but for addictions, there are solutions.  And when we have money flowing, maybe we'll all just take a nice vacation to Mexico, where they have chemical treatment for these addictions.  

I can't help it between you husbands and wives, but we're going to call it attitude adjustments, and there is nothing in the world healthier for a good attitude adjustment, is to be busy growing, and becoming.  It's wonderful.  They will come at you, your own enemies, and say, well, look how miserable you must be.  Who in this room is miserable?

We're having the most fun we've had in all of our experiences before, or in this one.  We have to complain a little bit about being a little overburdened to make sure that everybody notices that we're contributing something.  Can't we just share that?  So that our overall contribution is wonderful, and we're getting there because we know we need to rely upon one another. 

On the other hand, we also have grown up, and realize that that always is not possible.  It's very, very difficult.  The older you get, the more directional you become.  Or, you never could make up your mind in the first place for all those years, so you get set in an idea.  And along comes someone and says, well, you were set for poverty.  Your little setting, your little wind-up, and the little key was set over here to poverty... or lack of success. 

Well, what you've done is successfully set your dial over here to lack of success, but you are going to become the most successful failure around.  Well do you want to be a successful failure, with or without what you need, to do something worthwhile?  And would you sign away your future possibilities because you're pissed off, and you think somebody may be talking to someone who's phony.

33:33

This is what is really, really amusing, and I think these are the things that we're here to hear.  The gossip.  Look at the very traits of personality that go into play, to get you to right here, and let's look at it a little bit, and analyze it, and have a little fun with it.  I do know how to annoy.  I know how to make you so mad that you'll do exactly what I wanted you to do in the first place.  What will you do when ego has to strike out for survival?  Will you get it under control yourself, or will you wipe out absolutely everything there is as a potential, because you're immature? 

You might expect a kid to do this, but you better start giving up childhood, once you've missed those years of childhood.  Because there's nothing but a better way out there for all of you.  Any sort of chemical addiction that you have, we can get rid of.  You have to want to do it, because you're going to have to take a trip somewhere.  You can either make that a joyful pleasure, and a family outing, or you can make it miserable, but it will not be physically miserable.

We need whole people, not cripples.  We need to rebuild self-esteem, not ego.  We need to put ego down, and get real, True self-esteem, and a desire to move forward, and become what God knows you're worthy of becoming.  Even I, as a commander, do not make sloppy choices, and that's my ego speaking.  I know what you're worthy of becoming.  I know what your soul wants to become, and you will each have made your lessons, so that at some point here, all you've got to do is just stand for Truth. 

You don't have to fight, you don't have to do anything, except stand for Truth.  And when you have accepted a responsibility, and this always brings you back to the mundane of business, corporations, structures, responsibility of head of household, whatever your responsibility is, you do have to accept it, and you do have to take a stand.  It doesn't mean you take up an Uzi, or an AK-47 and shoot the other one.  

Or, if you're going to do that, why don't you just shoot the other one, and get it out of its misery?  But you don't do that, you eat it alive, because your only existence has been this sort of behavior.  It fills up your time.  You're bored, so why don't we develop something so we don't have to live in boredom?  Why don't we become so that life is vibrant, and we're passionate about it?  And we’re seeing the results, not just digging out from whatever went wrong.  

But as an example, after our friends over in the Philippines have kissed us off.  EJ says, well, you can't go without us having the authority to work without you.  Now we get, as we're leaving the hotel, right?  The little Bobsy Trio, me and my two kids, we're going to go to the Manila airport, and we’re trying to get out, wee hours of the morning, and everybody’s saying good bye, and there are two faxes.  One from Charles, and one from Rick, and now they're going to get these two on fraud.  

Oh, remember this well.  What you can do legally, lawfully, and rightfully, and righteously, within a corporate structure.  Those who didn't bother to find out what time of day it might be, are going to run into trouble.  Everybody remembers what they want to remember.  Rick writes his little document.  I'm going to go back all the way to V. K. Durham, and Rusty Herman.  

The arrangements were made with Hatonn, and Rusty Herman.  I couldn't send the Ekkers back when Rusty was dying, so we sent Rick, once again, fully expenses paid.  We sent him back again, after Rusty died, but you see, in good corporate structure, the person with the corporation may know very damn well what you're doing.  But now suddenly, Rick's gonna be rich, and Charles is just there.  I'm sorry, I don't mean to put him down by saying that.  I'm just saying, Charles was there.  

Charles was always there.  Charles read every incoming document in both the CONTACT office, and Ekker's house before anyone could get them.  He knew everything.  It got to be a joke around Ekker's house, you know...well, he might as well leave it on the top, or Charles will have to look for it, and why not just read it in front of you because everybody knew, see?

So, because of this, Charles would also make sure he was there for every phone call, and let's get it on the speaker system.  If you ask a personal question, Charles could always answer it.  He knew.  He knew before anybody knew.  But he certainly didn't know the right things, and Rick comes blundering through, and he writes up a document, and he says, “but I'm going to be a signer on this always”.  Oh, okay.  What do you want to be?  

Well, I don't know, but, you know.  Well, we're going to be working through this corporation, this one, this one, and this one.  And so now you're talking about being in Manila.  Well, what are you going to do?  You have four people there.  What are you going to do?  Oh, well, let's just make everybody a member of the Board of Directors.  Let's just make everybody a vice president.  Well, do you want that to show up on the records?  No.  Oh, well, okay.  We'll make you a Vice President.  Or would you rather be an executive officer?  Or what is it you would like to be?  Oh, well, I'd like to be a director.  Oh, okay.  Here we go.  But Mr. O'Bannon, or whatever nominee, shows up in the state records.  

You're going to have to sign all the documents, Mrs. Ekkers, so what would you like to be?  Well, I'd like to not be anything on any of it, if you don't mind.  I can tell you guys are going to dump all this on my desk, she says to them.  Oh, well, okay, maybe we could write a contract to so, and so.  Oh, okay, Rick would say, so he would be up, and bounded away, and he would come back with a hundred.  But you've misspelled the word ‘Consular’.  Consular General.  Consulate.  

[EJ] Commander?  

[Hatonn] Yes?  

[EJ] Can we interrupt you until we change our... 

[Hatonn] That's a good idea.…

[EJ] Machinery?

[Hatonn] I can always tell I'm home now.

UPDATE FROM HATONN - CORPORATE STRUCTURES & OTHER LEGAL GARBAGE, RICK LAWSUIT, LOTS OF MONEY & ASSOCIATED INTRIGUE

[Hatonn] I really am home. 

[Audience laughter]

[EJ] April 24th. 

[Hatonn] And headed for the millennium.  Bugs in the computers.  Well, this is just interesting because all of you better be thinking very carefully about these things.  And over in Nevada, you know, they're both having indigestion, palpitations, headaches, and oh, hot dog, somebody heard me with my lessons.  Somebody actually went to a seminar, and learned something.  Well, we were back doing seminars before most of you heard about corporations, so it pays off.  Don't ever let the lessons go by.

Oh, well, we have a corporation now, but an invisible energy form cannot be a member of the human aspect of a corporation.  So it's like, that's Hatonn's paper, or that's Hatonn's corporation, or that's, what did you say?   The judge said it very well.  It's you, I'm going to put in jail, Mrs. Ekker. So are you going to tell me that this invisible energy made you do it, Dr. Young?  And you do what?  You claim that this energy told you now that you're the head of it?  Well, this is when, if you look at it squarely, right on, it gets funny.  Don't stop seeing the humor in what you do, because these are the best, and easiest ways to learn lessons.

Make it funny.  Make it outstanding.  So, we sit in a room, and Rick decides to be a director, and I believe I'd like to be the treasurer, since EJ's the president, and Dharma has to do all the paperwork, so we'll dump that on her, and she can be the secretary.  Well, what about Charles?  Oh, he's just a witness, because he's always witnessing.  Well, but I'm tired of being a witness.  I want to be a director.  So, now we have a whole entourage of directors, and nobody's anything.  Corporately, nobody is anything.

Except the ones starting the corporations.  So, why get into a tizzy-do?  We can print business cards, and everything, and we'll even make you directors.  We'll do all the corporate paperwork, but right now, this afternoon, it's not feasible to do the paperwork.  We're in Manila, corporation’s back... God only knows where...in the basement somewhere.  But, so, they appoint themselves directors.  That's okay, because it really makes it a lot nicer if you're working with someone to be able to hand them a business card, or something, and they know a little bit about who you are, and what you do, and at least you're representing something.  

So time goes on, and now we're miffed.  We are so miffed that we're going to make secret arrangements to just get out of here.  Why would they be so miffed, and why would they not want to cause a big breakdown?  Because they think that the ones we have structured will be coming through with billions of dollars.  I'm not talking little bitty millions.  I'm talking damn near a trillion dollars, of which half would be something we could talk about.  

So we're not going to make the powers-that-be really miffed off.  So we'll keep everything a secret, but remember something, you don't keep secrets from God.  So it doesn't really pay to play the game.  Games are facades, and so you blunder, and you blunder, and you blunder.  Now I'm really ticked off at you, and we're gonna go home, and we're gonna do this, because we know it's all done.  We’re just waiting for Manny to get back, and tell us how much, it’s all gone, and all done. 

And he comes back into Manila 24 hours late, and they've got to go in the morning, because they've changed their reservations.  They've got to go early, and so the man didn't show up until 9 or 10 o'clock, so they had a bad period of time.  But coming right up to it, when they finally...I prodded them enough that they told us...that, oh yeah, well, we've already changed our reservation, for all these silly excuses.  You cannot go out of here without us having full written contractual agreements on doing business.  Oh, no sweat, we'll just do that.

Well, by the time they got done, they had relinquished every legal avenue of recovery.   They just signed their whole career away because they were pissed off.  And that's what you can do with good corporate structure, and it will stand in court.  And so what is the last paper about?  You defrauded us.  We can't find the contracts.  Well, there weren't any.  We can't find any appointment slips.  Right, there weren't any.  But how is it that the Ekkers defrauded them?

6:40

Were you not the secretary of this corporation, and the treasurer of this corporation, and the whatever of this corporation, why didn’t you do something about that?  You can blame all you want to, but you didn't do anything about it.  There's nothing there.  And then the biggie.  Always watch for the big one.  And we know that you removed our names from the bank accounts.  The big one.  The big bank account.  You know, the Global Alliance bank account?  In fact, they show no record of us ever being on the bank account?  Well, that's because they were never on the bank account.  Never.  They didn't even ask…. but we signed some cards.  That wasn’t a bank account, dummy.  That was your resignation.  From something you never were.  

But I put in my paper that I would always be a signatory on this.  What paper?  Well, you know the paper it’s right there.  But there was never an agreement.  You put it in there, nobody paid any attention to it, including the ones you gave it to.  And you're not going to come back here now, two or three years later, after you have set up, and destroyed.  And, oh, well, heck, maybe these people will do something. Well, we're not going to do anything we started out to do.  Nothing.  And these are the reasons.  We don't have to.  All we have to do is just keep funneling everything offshore to Mr. Jeffers, who is already now structured to be unlimited.  And we just go from there. 

And will it stand in court?  Of course it will stand in court.  Well, I’ll see to it that the documents are no good.  Oh?  V. K. Durham, Rick, has already said that is a fraudulent signature, is it?  Are you going to tell us after all these months of pure hell that is a fraudulent forgery?  You're the only one who ever touched it, Rick.  I don't think so.  Not if you haven't a shred of a connection in your brain.  Talk about dead almost instantly.  You do not play games like that with your friends.

Or you get, you really get deaded in many ways.  We have been tested in fire, tempered like steel, and we will not ever turn, and betray a friend.  And yet we had to find out who would betray us, and the funny thing is you don’t need adversarial speakers for these receivers who won't identify.  The truth was in there.  We're cleaning house.  They just misperceived who.  I don't see them around.  But they're going to have another lawsuit because of fraud in the paperwork?

Now what they did, was find out they couldn't usurp, or take one more thing.  And so in the trying to find out so that they could find out if there was anything, they found out there was nothing. And now we know where they go to find out.  So there won't ever be anything there, will there?  And each little step, each little crawl, you take it to your heart, and you stop dwelling on these little petty nothings. You don't need revenge.  You don't need to judge.  And you don't need to blame.

Because there are no mistakes in the programming.  There's only growth, or drop out, and we're not gonna drop out.  We're going to move on with the paper.  It may be a creepy-crawly start.  I can't let you have great, and massive funds, or you go in there like a big balloon, and they will burst all over you.  Well, they try to find out how you got it, what it is, where it is, and you will spend the rest of your life in court.  And I don't think it's that much fun, but we'll start with what's happening.  There will be a trial, a hearing, on this temporary restraining order on the 3rd in Las Vegas. So put it in your calendar.  This will have a confrontation.

And other things are coming along, but we set out this little segment of time to share, discuss, see where we want to go. I said earlier that we can be in the Global Alliance, and the Phoenix Institute will have its place.  But I for one, am ready to take the load off these people.  As soon as we can get it sorted around, we're not gonna wait to see what in the world will ever happen with Betty Tootin, and all... even after being kicked out of court again, George Green, and Abbott, and Horton went back, and appealed again to the Supreme Court.  And this was the case of Green against the boxes of gold.  It was so stupid, they threw it out the first time.  Now they've appealed it, at least the second time, to the Supreme Court.  No wonder the court system is so busy.

So on the 24th of June has to be a mandatory settlement conference, because they have no court of appeals in Nevada.  So they set up a judge, and you have to go.  And this judge, has said - Mr. Abbott, and Mr. Horton will produce their clients.  So any of you who want to see Horton, and his client Green, Abbott, and his client Leon Fort, and Eleanor Schroepfer, and I don't know how he's going to produce John, but they've gotten everything so entangled, that the Phoenix Institute cannot function. 

15:25

Well I'm tired of playing in that game, so one of the first things that we're going to do is just go outside the loop, and clean out the Institute.  With interest, we will not ask people to take a loss on their gold, because most people put their gold in when it was a hundred dollars an ounce higher.  But we're tired of taking the abuse, and the beating over that institute.

And I don't blame anybody, but you see, they continue to say ‘investors’.  There were no investors, there were lenders, and the judge in Nevada sat there on the bench, and said, these are not even due.  But years later, years later, it's still going on, and now new attorneys are trying to milk everything they can out of the Texas Overton gold.  And unless you pay, this was just last night, unless EJ, we get Randy paid in Texas, he doesn't even want to go back to court.  But we paid him!  What do you mean he doesn't want to go back to court? 

Well, his law firm's really at him, and I'll go further with Don Rhodes.  All his expenses paid over to Manila.  He wanted to go.  He got to go scuba diving off Palawan.  And there's a $15,000 bill sitting in the basement at Ekkers' house, that he wants to be paid on now because after all there's all this upset, and it's been eight months.  Well, it's still cheaper than building him a legal institute, isn't it?  So we may as well just get it all out there.  Let's just get it out there, and the interim funding will be enough for that.

And Jeffers has made a commitment that as soon as he can get these primary things, he will move offshore, and he will see to it that if other things are dragging, there's enough to take care of those things so that we can move without these harassments.  It isn't that the harassment is so much, is it the obligation within an honest soul, says “I'm indebted, and I don't want anyone to lose because of me”.  I will work to my dying day, these ones say, to make everything right.  Even things that are not their responsibility.  But I’d rather see it go that way, than to say, “oh well, what the hell, I'm through with this.  To hell with everybody, I'm going to go, and do what I want to do”.  Well they've really done it.

I don't know, I just don't know what will come, because everybody has Free Will choice, you can not judge what will happen in court, but Mr. Martin is practicing law.  They've joined, and supported him.  He holds their power of attorney, and it's the dumbest thing you've ever seen.  

[EJ] Say that again.  Rick holds the power of attorney for...

[Hatonn] Charles, Edwin Young, and Gail.  But it undoubtedly is not in law, and he couldn't let it go.  He didn't just take Rick's legal document.  He had to write, hand-write, a second page, which was incredibly worse than the first page.  And I don't want you to have fun at their expense. 

I want you to learn to do things properly, and out of all of this, the corporation agency could be in the worst position.  So we protect Nevada corporate headquarters to the full extent possible, and the players there, the people there.  We tend the corporate laws of the state of Nevada to the very, very last of our ability to do so.  The laws are not bad.  The people get swayed, and at some point along the way, you need a little distance, because the primary thing is to do proper business.  And if you are doing proper business, you’re going to get plenty of business to do.  

What has really happened is that over the years you've grown into stronger people, so that when these things hit you, well I don't know about Ellen maybe, when she gets socked with a lawsuit, or Bruce, what do I have to do with this?  And poor Kathy, well I might have agreed with something, but how did I get to be the one that did all of this?  Well we know better than all of that, but you better be ready, because they're going to blame you.  

Well, who told you that?  Kathy.  Now, maybe Kathy didn't do anything, but nod her head, or even maybe not that.  But who's going to blame us?  It's already... well...Kathy, and Gail.  Come on.  When people are desperate, they're going to nail you.  And you must be ready for it.  And you must be mature enough to not go to pieces with it.  And if you let anything slip, bring it out.  Put it out on the table. 

Well, I may have said that we had to do this, or we had to do that. Fine, put it out there.  And then we can all share in the openness of it.  And it takes away the game.  We need to clean this up.  I don't want people suffering for anything they might have done either intentionally, at any given point, or unintentionally.  If it involves us, let's clean it up. And if it costs us more, then let's clean it up, and pay it.  Don't haggle anymore over these little things.  If you can scrape something together by a Thursday, and something is due with an ultimatum on Thursday, pay it, and let's hope we get something by Friday.  Let's not go to war over anything else that we don't have to, because it slows us up.

On the other hand, you cannot go out, and spend millions of dollars until you can see it.  That's responsibility.  That's squarely facing what we have with which to deal.  And yet we had to bring it right down to the very bottom, in the protection of having nothing more to lose. Everything has served its purpose.  Now we're in this lull, and we've got to step over that threshold.  And my other inquiries that pour in, are along, what do we do with the Apple Center?  Well, it's not the best building or anything.  On the other hand, it is here, and you've got all this mess. Isn't it better just to go ahead and keep it for a little while until we sort, really sort?

And I can't see you paying anyone anything.  This was going into foreclosure.  This was an agreement with Keith.  Well, if his widow wants to try to save it, then we'll help her.  On the other hand, when you have someone spending the money out of the bank accounts, and you freeze those accounts, you have to wait again then until there's something in the account, and you think that you've got it covered, only to have the next check bounce, and wasn't that interesting to have it be made to the court.  

So it's been an experience for most of you.  But this is what happens.  And when you get down here, and you start building up, you're going to be busy, but we're going to make a go of it, and a go for it.  And if it's too much, we set it aside for a while.

I was interested in watching the response that we were getting from Ed, and Rick Martin, and so forth, about Diane and Tony Robbins.  Now that has gotten to be the silliest thing of all.  At least she has gone, and she has gotten to know people that literally could have put you on the map, product-wise, through the Tony Robbins Organization, and you know he’s on QVC.  This man is internationally known.  Can you imagine what Tony Robbins could do on QVC with [unintelligible name]?

So Diane had access, and has her catalog being done by the prime network internet person, with Tony Robbins.  And yet Ed and Young, I mean Ed and Tricky, Astral and Tricky, said not only was she squandering and irresponsibly using money, but it was on ungodly things, like Tony Robbins.  Well, what makes Tony Robbins ungodly?  And since when can’t you use the money out of your own company, while they're writing checks off of it.  That's called audacity.  In another language, it's called hutzpah.  

Are we sorry that some will not be with us?  Of course.  But let us be very careful why we're sorry. We're very grateful to know. We don't go around shunting anybody.  If you've really created a great atrocity in an Indian tribe, you may get banished for a while.  To get you out of the society, out of the structure, out of the circle, doesn't mean they shoot you.  Doesn't mean you can't be gracious, and have fun at dinner.  But you learn to respect.  And mostly, the sad part comes because you will have nothing in common with them longer.  But we have to know who will go, and who will stay the course with us.

And yet you'll find also that no one is totally indispensable.  And sometimes that's too much for the ego.  It's too much for the ego.  And they will wear this on their faces.  And they won't - “oh, look what we did, we got ‘em this time”.  They haven’t gotten anything, except themselves into a very, very mucky corner.

29:09  

And we don't want to just dwell on this to the point that nobody wants to take the paper, just because you've got to hear this garbage.  So these are things we need to work out within our own midst.  See where we want to go, who wants to do something, and let's move on toward that.

But these other things have to be tended, and we knew that it would be a bad weekend to come home, and have to live through this.  But it's better that we put it out here, and let's look at it.  They come back saying, “you know, Ekker's near death, and Dharma is a basket case”.  This is Alice.  “I love you dearly but”…

[Wally] Tough love

[Hatonn] oh yeah this is another term they really use with us - ‘tough love’.  “I love you but I'm going to kill you anyway, right after I strip you naked, and crucify you”, 

[Unknown person in audience] Take your money

[Hatonn] Especially the money.  “I’m taking everything that you have because I love you so much, and you're misdirected”.  

[Wally] And I may let you publish my book, if..

[Hatonn] Oh, I may come back, yes, if you're really good.  How wealthy have we gotten off of our own journals?  But we're going to be really sorry that we did this to Ray Binzer.  What I want to know is who's going to be willing to say who actually put their hands on the books to move them.  I notice that the ones who did that won't even help their neighbor move across the street.  Who went, and removed all of these marvelous books?  

But they certainly sucked a few people in who would rather not have been sucked in.  And the next thing you will get, well, Commander promised us, and promised us.  Well, now I notice that same old Commander that's staying now with Ed Young.  I am so glad to be rid of some of these Commanders.  The one you know, me that went with George Green, and now me who went over here with them, with Ed Young, and gave him all that responsibility, 100% responsibility for that CONTACT paper, and the bank, everything.  I mean... you know, Dharma now can stand in court and say, what? You know? I don't know, they all took that one I talked to. 

[EJ] You suppose that Duggar will graduate to Ed now? 

[Hatonn] Oh, I guess.  I guess so.  Except that he won't let her in because he's the astral connection.  That's your clue.  That’s your clue.  From the get-go.  Anybody who really is genuine would get rid of me.  Wouldn't wait for me to go running around, tampering with everybody's mind.  The ones of you who take this responsible... responsibility, and I bring that right into this room, will gladly be rid of me.  

But we're going to do it.  I'm not going anywhere.  We've got a staid nucleus here, from which to build.  And we need the paper now for a different purpose.  I needed it if we had closed it up after the public notices that validated us.  We kept our agreement.  Didn't matter what the notice said, particularly.  We kept our agreement.  This was a communication link.

But you know where it bogged down?  On the Ten Commandments.  And I suggested you shouldn't run around seducing people.  You're going to pay. Bitterly.  Now, you sure didn't want that put in the paper.  So we have some pretty good writings around, and these were comments asked for.  And I hope it works out well for everyone.  I don't see how that it will.  But if it does, it's because they shape up.

And they go, and build.  It's like the books.  Why sneak in, and put someone else in jeopardy, their career in jeopardy, their word, their honor, to move out some books that if they said they wanted, we would have helped them move.  And all it needs now, is just to stand strong, but please understand why.  Money doesn't just come flowing in, just sinking you in money.  That isn't the way to do it.  You have to keep that appearance of struggle.

I don't have anything, is your stance.  And you know what?  It is so honest.  It is so honorable when you don't.  If you don't have anything, honestly, then it's very easy to say, I don't have anything.  Go search.  Go do anything you want.  I don't have anything.  And if you’ve done your business well, even if you have something, you don’t have anything.  And you can do an honorable job with it.  And you know something else?  You will use it for the right reason.  How would you feel if I came along this very day, and said - ok we have it now, I want to put ten million, one million, five, five hundred million into your bank account, because I want it to go through your corporation, and then you put it over here in the Indian Bank when it opens.

And we'll purchase gold, and we'll show you how all the system works. Can you imagine this with betrayers? Do you think they're going to turn it over, back again?  And you know what the plum is, the cherry, you use it for anything you want.  That's yours.  The only price we ask is that you use the banking system. 

And if you have 500 or 50 different ones using the system, you can build your banking network very rapidly.  Part of our agreement with these people, the IMF, was that we would not do domestic transfers, and this was back when we were going to try to back everything with Global.  And we did issue some, and some little contracts.  Actually, they were big.  And some who helped us get to here, are sitting holding them.  And EJ was very nervous because he said, but we agreed not to do anything on a domestic level.  And I said, you're not.  Well, we just made these to these people.  Well so what?  There will not be domestic transactions.

You will stick that...when I suggested many places they could stick it, but I really suggest they stick it in the bank.  You know, the Navajo Bank, or the East Henderson, Nevada Bank.  Somewhere.  And it is never used.  It sits there.  It sits there.  That's one way we can assure that it sits there.  And it is not a domestic transaction.  It gives us a foundation upon which to test our system.  

And these are necessary things.  And when you're working as a domestic citizen of the United States of America, unless you want to move to the Philippines...it's harder to do business over there….so you really don't want to do that, until the citizens there get their system cleaned up. But if you’re a domestic citizen of Tehachapi, isn’t it easier to do offshore dealing over here at [unintelligible name of town] than in the Bahamas, if you have to go somewhere to sign something?

39:03

I need corporations to use, because if we're going to do it right, we're going to do it right.  And no, if I put ten billion dollars in your account, you can spend a little bit of it.  All you have to do is structure, and get it into security, and let us form a network to see how it can function.  But I'm not going to play with my enemies.  

Rick Martin proclaimed enemy.  Enemy.  That is the term.  Well, we may not want him for an enemy, I don't want him for a friend, and he doesn't really want me for an enemy.  And I don’t have to do anything.  Not diddly-squat.  But you are the functioning human beings.  And you will be held responsible.  And you will be responsible.  

And it's hard to go through these, I suppose you call them throes of... whatever you want to call it, but not really, because your heart tells you when there's something wrong. HATONN’S ‘RETURN’ MEETING CONTINUES – EGO, MISSION, DISCERNMENT, SORTING, STAY THE COURSE.

[Audience laughter]
