[Hatonn] His will sell better than yours. 

[EJ] Here we go. 

[Unknown person] Back on. 

[Hatonn] The greatest thing that you will ever experience is when you finally have subdued...and I don't mean some conscious effort to subdue something by force, but when you truly grow into the realization that you have totally outgrown, in your living experience, this need to feed ego. You don't have to have something happen, or demand to be superior, or demand to be heard, or whatever.  It doesn't matter to you.   

You are working in your purpose when you know that almost everything else in this whole world is more important, than what you think other people think.  Because that's what you're dealing with, with ego.  What are other people going to think about me?  Well, always act in such a way that you don't have to think about what they may be thinking about you, because basically they aren't.  They're thinking about themselves.

So now we have a clash of egos.  Each one thinking about self, is not allowing you to think about the other.  So you have to come out of it, and out of self, and give.  And when you begin to give, and when you begin to pray for another, and you really begin to work toward making life better for another, you'll find you're not even interested in most of the things that you were before.  

And the acquisition of things, oh, God, one more thing for me to try to find a place to put away... will become the primary thought.  When you look at something, and yet, God gives abundance for you to be able to experience and have things.  Keep it simple.  Know that you're only using for a little while something.  It's God's.  Use it if it pleases you.  Give it away.

Whatever.  Don't marry it.  And I use that term, I hope, with wisdom.  Don't marry it.  I would go through life just having people make commitments they keep, than to get married.  That is the beginning, usually, of the end.  Because somehow now you must struggle to hold it.  Just like you do things.  Oh, I thought.. I can't let this go….I won't let this go, uh well, I'm going to let that go.  I'd like to throw that out, but somehow I better not, because she'll want it.  

When you can look at the physical environment around you, and be in it, and be able to walk away from it... I don't mean that you won't grieve. Oh, that porcelain vase is now smashed.  And very frequently, you'll say, well, that was $1,200 smashed.  Might as well have taken $1,200, and burned it.  Well, then burn it.  If it becomes so infernally important to you, get rid of it.  Because you're still buried in ego, and having, and possessing are two different things.  You can have in freedom.  You cannot possess in freedom, and God is freedom.  Freedom of will, freedom of choice.  God is open Freedom.

Most people cannot respond to that.  They are so accustomed to thinking, oh, well, I must listen to the authority figure because this is my set of guidelines.  And once that is removed, and I can make my choices... unless you have a stable foundation, you will invariably make wrong choices because those will be the most tempting things.  And this is the difference in finding purpose, versus just having a goal.  

You may achieve your goal, but it may not have anything to do with your purpose. And that goal achievement, you won't even realize most of the time that you achieved it.  You'll get on top of that mountain and say, is this all there is?  A view on four sides instead of three?  And I didn't mean to get into this lecture.  I did too.

[Audience laughter]

But I wanted to impress all of you with the very reasons that those on the other side of our little chasm here, are acting the way they're acting.  And the reason you're responding the way you are.  And ones can come in, like Marina, and say….oh, okay, you're going to be able to tell by their faces.  The ones who are on the right side, are going to be much happier.  That other side is gonna be miserable.  Well, I want to... have you looked at the faces of that other side?  That are now so rapturous?  

I want you to also beware of a teacher who teaches in unknown tongues.  This is very, very serious.  Because, usually the receiver doesn't understand it either, and they'll be the first to say - “I don't understand it”.  Well interpret it, and it may or may not be even relevant.  You can only interpret anything according to its relationship to your experience.  If you ask Doris something, she's going to give you an opinion out of her existence.

And she has every right to her opinion, the same as you do, but the moment she voices something, it's attributed to me.  Well, isn't that ridiculous?  I speak in English with her.  I will sometimes use a few Native American phrases.  But you can go look those up.  I will not babble to her.  In Gargoylesian, or something like that.  I have occasionally written, by hand-script a few things, that as you move along, you will recognize having seen.  So that's important.

But don't go gung-ho for ones who babble.  Because that's what it is, babbling.  And you can only base the interpretation on the opinion, or interpretation of that receiver.  It doesn't mean that that interpretation is not correct, but it means it's confusing.  So why would you not speak in a language that everyone in the room can understand, or get an interpreter?  A translator?  

Is there any other house-cleaning we need to do?  Because these are the things we have got to grow beyond. 

[Audience member asks a question]  Excuse me.  Commander, which language does Marina speak, when she speaks in this foreign tongue?  Is it an ancient language or..? 

[Hatonn] It is no language at all.  I'm sorry... Sometimes she reverts to a type of Aboriginal, or Native... but it is not Native American, and you would not recognize it.  It's basically an Amazonian chant, and it has meaning, but Marina doesn't know what it means.  And I don't mean to... hear me.  I do not intend, nor want to diminish the connection, or put anyone down, because with her it is truly an expression.  On the other hand.. I would... I'm going to warn you... it will will pop out at the most remarkable times, when Marina is upset.  And that energy will pull her away.

I've warned everybody about this.  When those energies are asked to depart, or whatever, they will take the receiver with them, every time they can.  And that's... I..I don't have to have my people all... who have never been in the room, but any of you who have been in the room when this happens...and Marina will get up, and stomp out.  I'm sorry... a lighted energy would not ever do that.  

[Same audience member asks another question]  Commander, when she said that Sananda came through, or Mother Mary, were they really coming through her, or.. were those other entities? 

[Hatonn] Well, I would guess that probably if she called on them, they would come.  I don't, I, I'm not here to judge what Marina receives.  I said this too, from onset.  Don't ask me to comment about other receivers, or other energy forms.  Trust your own.

[Same audience member asks another question] Because at one time when Mother Mary came through, and Mother Mary said, “I bring you roses”, I really smelled roses.  Or was that just an imagination? 

[Hatonn] Only you would be able to interpret that.  I can't interpret that for you.  But no, it's very possible, it's very probable.  

[Same audience member] I also felt Sananda's energy many times. 

[Hatonn] Then that's wonderful.  Experience the Truth of whatever is happening.  Just don't let anyone, including Dharma, or Doris, run you.  Hear yourself, your God.  Anybody can talk.  Only you can interpret for self.  Well.. she seems so nice... or will he seemed so sincere?  Of course!

Everybody's nice, and everybody's sincere.  So you can only judge by the lesson, or the word.  If I tell you to - let's all go outside now, and then I will distract, and you run around, and rob the bank.  Now is that something God would tell you to do?  And neither would God tell anyone to take his child up on a mountain, and kill ‘im!  And any father that would take his son up there, hearing these mysterious voices, and get like this... and then the angels stopped him.  Bullshit!  

God is a creator, not a destroyer, and he does not test in that manner.  He may test the man, but the child is the one who suffers, and never would God ever treat an innocent child to that terror.  Where his father is above him with a knife.  Oh, well never mind, son, God told me to do it.  Be careful!  And don't be gullible.  Measure Truth.  Because Truth is whatever it is, to whomever it comes.  Your Truth may differ from someone else's opinion, or definition of that Truth.  

I go back to there is only one, and there is one common Truth.  But there are as many ways to reach this conclusion, as there are individual, and unique beings.  And if there is any breaking of God's or man's laws, it just... it's invalid.  But, there may be something very valid in the overall presentment.  Take the Truth, and toss out the other!   Don't turn someone into your conscience.  You're the one listening.   You are the one receiving.  And you are the one perceiving.  

And as far as you, Valerie, what Bruce thinks may have absolutely nothing to do with what you think.  You must interpret...if it's against the laws of God, or against the laws of the land, it's wrong.  It's that simple.  

[coughs] I'm pushing my luck.  We need a drink, or we need to take a break.  What time is it? 

[EJ] It's one o'clock.  We've been here three hours, and it's close to lunch time. 

[Hatonn] Do you want to go further today? 

[Audience member] Yes. 

[Hatonn] Then let's do whatever you want to do, and come back. 

[EJ] Let's be back here at two-thirty. 

[Hatonn] Very good.  Two-thirty, salu, have a nice lunch.

[Hatonn] hope.. you can always wish, you can make excuses.  This is what you're best at.  Make excuses for someone.  Well, you know, they were this, and they were that, and everybody didn't know, and we are here to have a small meeting anyway.  It's hard when you know.  Because it's so final.  

And doesn't God give you till the eleventh hour?  That's right.  But that's to save your soul.  And you make a choice.  That isn't to run a mission.  This isn’t to run a program.  If you're going to build a building, you have to start with a foundation.   And you have a different foundation if you're going to have a 35-story building, a 102-story building, or a one-story building.

You have to consider the wind factors, the geophysical impact.  And yet you go through life in this little, short, blink of an eye, wasting a lifetime.  Usually on the wrong foundation.  What if you did not have an architect, and you just start slapping down the walls, and so forth? You're going to have a ramshackle building.  

Now this may be fine, if you're going to put midgets in there.  They may not break the walls down.  You've been in a decade of training, for many lifetimes, and I'm kind of glad now that she's getting a little weepy-eyed.  Because there’s a grieving over disappointment.  And once again, you have to consider ego.  

Not in the sense of... I want to be bigger than anyone.  But how can they do this, when you're not even present?  What can you be doing to them, while you're out making every effort that you possibly can, to make sure there are no losses to anyone?  And it’s as if you’re not supposed to bleed.  

We can insult you, and then call it love, ‘tough love’, but you don't bleed.  Your heart doesn't hurt.  I mean, after all, you're a phony.  So expect the grieving, because of the disappointment, but revel in the joy of knowing that once you now keep going, you have dependable people.  And if a man can have one dependable friend, the journey's been worth it. Most have none.  And that one often vacillates back, and forth, because that's life.  

Ekkers didn't say anybody had to make a choice.  I said there must be choices, and we can come back, and we can get started, and money can begin to flow, when the time is proper.  And the decisions are made.  And some are still trying to drag their feet, but I know who they are.  And I make no judgment on them other than they're very wise to get out of my way.  But of course it's sad.  You have become.. over a long period of time... at least a break in the monotony.  And have compassion, because there's great sadness within. 

And oh, it's going to get worse.  Because there will be the sorrow of having made the incorrect choice.  I am not telling you that you need to choose for some Commander Hatonn.  Or a mission.  But if you're going to do that, you'd better be very careful what you do.  You shouldn't have signed up for the mission, if you were not capable of seeing it through. Well, didn't you know? - comes the little response from out of this head….didn't you know who would stay the course, and who would not?  And of course I knew.  And I know.

And will you be the unsung heroes out there?  Yes, because you will plan it that way, so that you have some sanity in your existence.

And just the hope, just the hope...and Terry experienced this... just the hope in the faces of these people, like the Ambassador from Iraq. Who will we have to pull from?  Who will we have to run the computers? Well, let's get a grandson.  They can work circles around you on a computer.  There will be someone, go and hire someone.  Go hire Linda.  If we have the money to do the mission, we're going to have the money to hire the help.  And you will be so glad that the burden's off your head.  If you hire somebody, and you respect them with adequate pay, and they don't do a job, then you can fire them.  

But look what happens when you have volunteer help, or they consider low paid help.  They'll get you.  And they'll break you.  They will break the back of your business.  They will steal from you, and you have witnessed it.  And I have allowed it to happen, because I want to clean the structure, clean the house, and have people we can depend on.  Well, but we did have a good paper, you know.  I'm playing both sides of this, because I have this digital thing going around in her head.

Beware.  When the children play all night, and they are not available to do a job in the daylight.  Watch out.  You should.. should.  Maybe the word is ‘could’.  You could have known trouble was brewing.  Trouble from day one was happening.  I told Ed Young to move off that tunnel.  Oh, well, he didn't want to go through the bother.  Bother?  For goodness sakes, even the rug sifted sand down into his lower level.  And he had to paper it with plastic wrap, to catch this insane dust that he was allergic to.  Trouble?  Too much of a problem, and trouble to move off that confounded tunnel where they were manipulating him?   

And then Nori comes, and Nori moves in with him.  And then Nori quits his job.  What are they doing over there?  He would not go, and ask for help for that paper, he would take from us, and us, and us, and take, and take, and take.  And now he's going to the very ones that helped us, to get his money to fight us.  And she wants to cry over it?  Spare me.  

[Laughter]

Nori is the loss.  I think you'll find that the way will open up.  And yes, there will be some sad points, if you linger on them.  And there have been some transitions made.  Zita.  John.  Lydia.  Seems like Rick did the weddings, and Dharma got the funerals.  I'm not sure one's any better than the other.  In fact, maybe that funeral is at least a progression into better.  Less confusion, not better.  Poor choice of words.  I don't think there's anyone in this room wants to quit, or you wouldn't be in this room. 

[Unknown audience member] Well, you said we're just about on phase two here. It’s not time to quit.

[Hatonn] E.J. went down, when he was summoned, to evaluate Dharma's basket caseness ...

[Laughter]

and they were lined up, both of them at the door, you know, to read this.  It's an underwriting.  And I knew this was going to be an interesting morning.  And I had meetings with the Sultan of Brunei, and we're going try to work out some incredible business things.  And now we’re going to have to figure out who is going to be on the team... that they had not told... they had kept their secrets, and I knew it was going to out, and it was going to out then, if I had to tell them myself.  Which I practically did.  And just what are you gentlemen planning?  Nothing, you know, just nothing comes back.  

But they haul EJ off down to the room, to read this underwriting...that this dark energy obviously has taken over Dharma...so, it's your responsibility to go down there, and beat her to death, or whatever might be next.  This is something else.  God may test you, but he does not test in this way. He does not hop in between a man, and his wife, to try to make it worse!  What did they think they were going to accomplish?  Total separation is what they wanted.  They didn't dare hit EJ.  They had to hit Doris.

But they over-calculated.  It didn't work out well, because whatever these two may not have, they have teamwork.  They work well together. And surely enough, EJ said, “oh well, I tell you gentlemen, what I witness here, from a long time of experience, you both remind me of people who do not know what to do with success.  People will get right up to the step, and the next step is the big one.  And you will do yourselves in because you're afraid of success”.  

And that's what it looks like to me.  We're going to get something done here, and you want to run off, because they were already talking about leaving, but they did not say they had already changed reservations.  So EJ goes back to the room, and he said, well, I think that I want you to think about some things.  And just clear your space, and see what you come up with.  

And she came face to face with me -  I want a meeting, please.  Let's just take it right out of your hands, EJ, get him down here, right now. We're going to clear up some things.  We're going to go over my writing this morning, that seems to be objectionable to everyone...and dark. Let's just get ‘im down here right now.  But that's the problem.

Rick shot both of his feet off beforehand.  Now he's having to creep, because he has to get back here to Tehachapi to cover the books.  And then they acted like silly little brats.  Is that what you want marching with you across forever?  Have you not done this enough times before? That you need the physical stamina, and strength of a brotherhood that does not cut your throat.  

Well, you've got to learn to have your throat partially cut, and you're going to have to bleed a little, to see if you will stay the course.  So we came back without money in hand.  I think everybody here will understand why that was necessary.  We can go from here, now.  So you don't have to wait a lot longer now.

It can burst through all over you.  You have to now be prepared to move, to use it, to go with it.  But to bring wealth back into a broken house, is incredibly stupid.  It would not work.  If you think you have a little pain, and grieving, over confused people, oh, when the betrayers are in your midst, and you're talking millions, and billions of dollars meant for programs, while they go squander, and play, and spiral downward against everything that you've worked for, it would break your heart. They needed the experience, you needed it.  Lessons are for everyone.  

There are no negative lessons.  There are only positive.  You can respond to them any way you wish, but there are still lessons, there are still choices, and there are no bad ones.  A wrong choice simply produces some kind of result.  And then you can work with it because you have a result. And that's the only sure thing there is.  Results.  Something is going to happen.  If you choose to do absolutely nothing, and just sit like this, you're going to get results.  You're going to die, is what you're going to do, and your skeleton may still sit there.  But you will have a result with which to deal.  Every choice has a result.  

You see, I can read your minds.  I don't want you to start trying to pretend thoughts to me.  

[Laughter]

But I know, I know these two.  If you wanted to start a paper, Ed, let us help you.  We'll help you.  Spectrum's a pretty good name, you know, and you're writing about the Rainbow Masters, and all the while Hatonn is saying, who needs another book from the Rainbow Masters?  They copied all of our first one, and said so.  How many duplicates do you need, and you have devoted two years to selective advertising of those books.  And then complain because more money doesn't pour in.

Oh, I don't think so.  I don't think this is sad.  This is glory, and nobody had to do anything.  This is the point.  This is the lesson.  People make their choices, and you don't have to do anything.  But you do have to stand strong.  Well what if they come over to the meeting, you know?  Well, welcome them in.  Don't you think I can handle it?  They will come.  Just as we were talking before the lunch break. They…

[Tape ended abruptly at 41:25]

tapes.text:
990425-1b

6-25-24
Paul

HATONN AT HIS BEST – “SO SOME OF YOU ARE RIGHT HERE AT YOUR GRADUATION.  TO MOVE ON TO THE NEXT PHASE.  WILL WE GET IT DONE?  YOU’RE CONFOUNDED RIGHT, WE WILL GET IT DONE!”

[Hatonn] I will get rid of the dark energies, and we'll see who's left.  Because when a dark energy settles in, and I say, “get out!”...and I will light this room if I have to, and I have done it....

[EJ, laughing] Do it again..

[Hatonn] But ah, the dark energy only has to move to wherever I tell it to.  It'll back off as far as I demand.  But it will take its receiver every time it can.  And if you don't have the strength of the relationship that you obviously have with God, substantial enough, you'll get flipped off, and you'll go.  And you'll slam the door, and you'll mumble under your breath, “screw you”, and all these wonderful little things.  I'll show you.  That's the big one.  I'll fix you.  Surely you're smart enough to know you don't want me for an enemy.  Well, aren't they smart enough to know they don't want me for an enemy?  I haven’t lost a round yet.

I have the advantage.  They have the handicap.  I just.. I'm sorry, it's that way.  And I can get rid of the energy that's supporting them.  And if you think those energies won't dump you like a hot potato, guess again.  So, Dharma will say, “oh, well, we shouldn't have gone away so long, because people need the support”.  There are people who have never laid eyes on Dharma, who have never wavered in the support.  You didn't come here for Doris or Dharma.  You certainly did not come here for Ed Young, because he was bored too much to even come to the meetings on time.

So don't tell me that any of you came here to experience the energy, astral, or etheric form of Ed Young.  So the confusion comes up.  I must make choices.  I must make choices.  Yes, you must.  But decide on what you're choosing.  Well, I don't know if Dharma's Hatonn is the right one. Will the real Hatonn really stand up?  Would you recognize him if he did? If you think he's somebody else?  

But my travels are grossly exaggerated.  And think back, and enjoy yourself.  Have some humor.  George Green is going to run off with what? The paper... And then he announced he had Commander in tow.  Commander was no longer in Tehachapi, he had gone to Nevada with George, and Desiree.  Aren’t you experiencing deja vu all over again?  Well, how do I prove that I am the one?   I don't have to prove anything to anybody.

Somebody better start trying to prove something to me, and let's start right now with how many meetings did Hatonn have with you, with Dr. Young?  I thought not.  How many meetings did Nori have?  Or did Callie rush over here to have a meeting for you?  What is this?  What is the confusion?  You don't know.  I really kind of... and one or two of them were vacillating about showing up in here.. to show me.  Oh, I just... come on, come on Ricky, come on.  Just come in here.  

I will demand their energy show up.  And don't think that every experience you have, is not a lesson in training.  Before Dharma was even really receiving from me, she knew it was me, and she knew who it was, but she had to lay down on the couch, and put on her blindfold, and do all this stuff that... because nobody said what you're supposed to do. Just a minute, just a minute.  And (unintelligible name) the only speaker on Earth for the silver ray, and Virginia Essenes, who spoke for the golden ray, the Christ ray.  Well, who are they?  

Oh, I thought you'd never ask me, dear.  The silver ray is the ray of creation, the silver cord, the grandfather, if you will.  In the native tongue, or the native language.  This is grandfather.  Then over here you have the golden ray, only they're all wound up like a DNA structure.  If you can picture a DNA spiral, it is interwoven with the silver, and the gold, and becomes crystal light.  So we can have a lesson here on the harmonics of light, but I'll spare you.  

Oh my...There had been a real confrontation in the morning.  There were guests in Ekkers' home, and they were handing out orders like...this one may not be in the room, and that one may not be in the room, and so forth, and so on, and we expect to use the front room, and we'll let so, and so in.  But they wouldn't let Dharma in.  

So after the meeting... and they're ready to go, we're going to have a little meeting.. And you’re gonna put Hatonn in his place.  And so Ann gets herself all into a nice trance, that was such a pretend farce, that you wanted to throw up.  And they go through all their rituals, and poor Virginia didn't know what had hit her.  

And finally Virginia speaks up, and said, “how can you be harsh?  Don't you understand that this is the only earth speaker for the silver ray?"  And I said, um, “I understand that you think so, but I don't acknowledge it, and I don't believe so.  So let's just start from there.  Get your energy here now”.  Oh, my energy is... my speaker is here.  No, he's not.  I said, get him!

And then it's a lot more fun for Dharma to tell the story, because she would crawl under the couch if she'd fit.  And Grandfather, with all the feathered robes, just floated, walked, right over the couch. And got between Anne, and her.  “And he said, now let's talk about it.  Your energy is not here. You are not going to continue with this train of demand”.   And we headed out.  And as usual, as usual, up she got, and away she went.

And Virginia was with her, so she says, oh, well, ahem.  And Anne, in the garage, made Virginia make a choice.  If you stay in this house, if you do not live with me now, our relationship is over. Well, Dharma and EJ didn't know they had this relationship, but I thought maybe it's time we open eyes.  So then they had to think, oh my goodness, silver ray had done a magnificent reading that has all come to pass in this valley. Right to that piece of property.  

Well, but that seems so real.  It is real, don't you understand me?  And when you have heard the prophecies, they're up here.  There is nothing remarkable about a speaker, and a receiver, but the listener has to hear something.  And if you've listened to your lessons, you will know it does not mean you have to judge anybody, but confront these people, and they will run.  So I know how to do it.  
10:10

Well, that isn't very nice.  You always knew, sir, where to pick on Rick. Little Rick?  Come on.  These people will say that doesn't dignify an answer, and go.  If it is right, it dignifies itself by answering.  Don't give me that, “oh, I wouldn't even dignify that with a response”.  That means you're a lying SOB.  And how long will you not allow the dignity, and the respect, and the reverence for God, and the host, because you wouldn't dignify with an answer.  

So we've had several years to graduate these people, and you. Your diplomas are ready.  Isn't that amazing?  All these others think they're running around with their graduation papers in hand?  No, you're the one graduating.  They're just boycotting the graduation.  That's what the Khazarians do.  Anybody notice a similarity?  

Do you know when I lost Rick?  I told him he had Jewish blood. On this trip. I said, watch it, Rick.  He was like a little old lady, who has a shopping addiction.  He could not go across the street to the mall, without going shopping, and dickering over price, and everything, and it was serious, it was being discussed amongst other people.  You might as well have brought, quote, a Jew in here.  Well, he's a Jew.  

You cannot help being what you are, but you can help acting like the more undesirable characteristics involved.  And I handled it very gently, but it was getting out of hand, and this is, after all, my program.  I'm not going to let it be botched by a set of hard metal rock computer speakers.  
He bought two or three sets of them to go with his computer.  And I said, we have to go very carefully here.  Please, let’s go very carefully here, because these are the observations being made.

If anybody would ask at the table, “what do you do, Charles”?  Well, he would respond with, “I pay the bills”.  I guess that means you take your card, and you go over, and you run it through, because EJ was paying the bills.  Well, Rick froze.  He started to respond by... and then he finally did say... well, I mean, he's, he's crimson, he's so angry.  And he said, “no, we had that checked out thoroughly”.  Why would you have it checked out?  What is this?  That's about what I said to him. What is this?  You are what you are.  We are what we are.  

It's really interesting how each race will covet another. If you're black, you want to be white.  If you're white, you go lay in the sun until you cook.  And you go to the Philippines, they're bleaching their face.  It's..it’s insane, is what it is.  You are what you are.  And all that is reflected there, with this thing that you call house, this form. It is not you!  So what are you?  Oh, we're soul, and we're essence, and we're vapor, and we're astral, and we're etheric, and we're all these things.  Yes, you are!  All of these things.  And you can't change what you are.  Only your response, and your reaction to the circumstances.  

But that's when the cord was cut.  Do we want someone?  Actually, it gets a little worse than that.  One of the people that we're working with over there is Jewish.  Goes right to the synagogue over there.  He and Don Rhodes, who is also Jewish, got along extremely well, and they even went to the synagogue once.  Together.  Don didn't make many bones about it.  He was really quite impressed that he got to be 53...he's the oldest known bar mitzvah child, or celebration, or celebrant, something like that.  He wanted to say that he was Jewish by choice.  Well, but his family's Jewish, I guess.  Does it matter?  Can't people work, and be what they are, because they're productive, or talented?

Or do they have to come forth with an almost genetic trace of the tribe?  It's only learned behavior.  Can't you have respect?  Can't you have reverence for that which makes life so incredibly wonderful?  The diversity.  But these are the ways you find, truly, the bigots.  And I want to know what you can do about it.  Dharma could go lay in the sun for fourteen days, and cook, and she'd just freckle, and turn red.  She would not become bronze, and beautiful.  We're going to outgrow that. 

You.  You.  The Y-O-U of you, is light.  And that means you are a compiling... a compilation of every color there is in the universe.  And you're made up of the elements of the universe.  To be the servant of the soul.  You are a spiritual being, and you've chosen to have a physical experience, as human.  Why human?  Why didn't you come back as a dog or a cat?   Because the human is the Creation’s gift with reason.  The ability to think, to reason, and to choose, free will choice.   And because you are human, you have the right to be equal to any other human.

And when you take your responsibility for that which you are created to be, you become a human being co-creator.  That's what you're all working for.  I don't care which direction you're scattering.  The one sole driving purpose of HUman is to reunite with that which he is.  And you will search, and you will seek, and you will come back, and come back, and come back, until you get it done.  So some of you are right here at your graduation.  To move on to the next phase, will we get it done? You’re confounded right, we will get it done!  And yes, most will come back, and want to tag along.

20:18

No tagging along.  You may serve with us, through us, we may help you, whatever they want we may supply.  But no tagging along.  No riding on someone else's coattails to victory.  But you'll have what you need. Thank you for just being honest enough to say, we’ll buy it.  This is a great equalizer, too, when you have something you can call currency or value.  That's something that human understands.  You must have the ability of independent survival, capability, availability.  That means you don't rush to a town to live off someone else.

You come to a town being prepared to build.  That's what usually happens with the commune.  Everybody tosses in their money, and pretty soon you're all fighting.  You have to be self-sustaining, or you drain from someone else.  But these are simply experiences.  Could we make it through without literally being labeled, and proven to be some kind of a cult?  

It's very hard because you don't know what to call a group, except a group.  But the minute you call yourself a group, uh-oh, on TV they're going to call you a cult.  And then when you go, and deliberately set yourself up as the guru, the astral etheric authority that can edit, edit the very speakings, you've just formed a cult.

I don't want to be part of it.  I don't want it anywhere around me.  And most of you have experienced over these years, and certainly Ekkers have, they don't want ‘em around them either. They’re sick to death of courtrooms, and ridicule, and being threatened to throw you in jail, the day they burn Waco.  The day they burn Waco!  How dare they come out here and tell Ray Bilger or Ray Bilger tells other people, rides to Bob Nakaya, don't go out to that farm!  That's why I moved.  They have an arsenal out there.  They have guns out there and they expect another Waco out there. Bob Nakaya got this from Al.  Al called him.  This is unacceptable.  

[EJ] Is this a recent occurrence?

[Hatonn] Yes. Yes. 

[Unknown audience member] Did you get it from Al or from Ray? 

[EJ] Ray and Al? 

[Hatonn] Both. 

[EJ] Who's Bob Nakaya? 

[Hatonn] He was here yesterday with Maggie and Les Zobel.  He's Les' wife's son.  He wants to do the farm.  He is a landscape architect.  He wants to manage the farm.  He doesn't necessarily need to live it. You've got so many wonderful things to experience.

Spelt is only one product.  There is now a recognized product in the United States of America, and now being grown commercially in the Philippines, is, it is, is a hibiscus plant-like.  But it can be treated also as a very fibrous plant, annual.  And it makes the best paper, the best fiber products.  It can be baled into cubes for cattle feed.  It is one of the most versatile, useful plants since hemp.  But you can't have hemp.  So we need to experiment with some of these things.  We need the research, and educational development that the Institute offered, but we don't need the Institute to do that.  And you don't want to be under constant assault, everything you do.

But don't tell me, you love me, while you're cutting my people's throat. But you see, they already had done it.  They had severed Hatonn.  But they don't just sever, so let's think about that again for a minute.  You might say, God damn... are you cursing?  Are you taking the name of God in vain?  Depends on how you intended it.  Mostly, it is a, God damn it. So it doesn't mean anything.  Taking God in vain is doing what they’re doing.  You see, my higher form is Aton, the Light.  And I play around wherever I want to.  Everybody wants clues.

Let me give you a big one, that so far I haven't noticed anyone noticing. Do you really think God would choose one people over another people? This reminds me of war.  God's on our side.  We only lost three people. They lost five.  What in the world is this?  I'm going to go on the football field now, and bloody everybody on the other side.  I'm going to pray first, and ask God to let me win. Win, win.

Why don't you just pray to be honorable?  And stop this.  This incredible nonsense.  And stop thinking of yourself all the time.  I just don't know.  What about me?  I just don't know my relationship with, with this. Uh, well, I just don't know.. um.. well what happens to me now?  Who the hell cares?!!  Well I care, that's why I'm asking you what's going to happen to me now.  Well, why don't you wonder what's going to happen to Bruce or Valerie, or Audrey, or you name it.  Why are you hung up on self, and feel abused?  You are given the greatest gift on earth today.  And you're going to be given the abundance to go with it.

And you're going to piss, and moan.  And you're going to piss, and moan until they hang you with the golden rope, and then you'll complain about that, too.  I don't mind complaints.  I don't mind a little bit of confusion, or talking about it, but for goodness sake, get your brain together.  

You're not confused.  You don't want to give up this relationship, or that relationship.  And they think, and they say... who cares what they say?  Well, can all the world be out of step?  Yeah.  In fact it’s easier to get everybody out of step, marching along to the drum beat.  That takes nothing, and I'm sorry to go, and commit suicide, or be martyred, is nothing that is a cop-out.  That is just a cheap way to get out of it.  

Only you don’t get out of it.  You meet it squarely on the other side of that veil.  Where you wish you hadn't done it.  Because of the responsibility that goes with it.  It's murder, and thou shalt not kill. You're not supposed to kill little unborn babies, and you're not supposed to commit suicide.  But don't you understand that it's all right if you do?

You just have consequences for your actions.  It isn't a solution.  It's a very selfish way to go.  Because obviously you're only thinking of self, in the relief of whatever pain you're having, or I'll just blow my brains out, and get it all over with.

30:10

Will you really?  Not only will you not get it over with, but there are special places, even in the astral plane, where these energies go who make that terrible choice, because they cannot justify to the life.  And they will isolate themselves even in the etheric form.  So there are guides that specialize in tending these souls.  

Then there are the commitments, or the contracts, that take ones to allow for something else to happen, that impacts what is left.  You don't know another's contract. You don't but what the gift of a Charles Neal, and a Rick Martin, and a Gail Irwin might be.  So you graciously, on your knees, thank them for the gift they've given you.

So that you can make your choice, and grow into the realization it was the right one.  And Dharma says, “well, maybe if you do come through with, you know, the wherewithal to do this”.  This comes from ten, twelve, fifteen, twenty years of patience.  

Ed Young, like I said yesterday, gave me ten days.  And therefore, I knew it would take eleven or twelve, before we could do anything.  Don't give God ultimatums.  And don't make promises that you know fully well, you probably won't keep if it works out.  If God keeps his bargain, it's all right because you have right up to the 11th hour to say, well, I really didn’t mean to betray you.  These people have not betrayed you.  They betrayed themselves.  

They have not hurt you.  You have gained.  You will grow.  It doesn't matter whether you have a paper, or you don't have a paper.  But we will have a paper.  Bruce wants a paper.  We need a paper.  We need to communicate, and we need to get the prophecies out, if nothing else.  But that's only part of what needs to be done.  Why shouldn't we all experience success?  Do something worthy of God's pride in us.  And it takes a lot.

And therefore you will create a way, and you will have a lot.  And will we lose some others?  Will some of you?... Dharma will vacillate from day to day.  Jeez, I must be as bad as they say, or at least partially that bad.  How could I have misled people?  Misled?  What have you misled?  People are not supposed to have a ring in their nose, with a string.  How smug, and arrogant of you to think you might have led somebody astray.  

Does everybody in this room hear me now when I say you're arrogant to think that?  And you’re not going to tell me how to spend my money, is what came back.  Just don't try to tell me how I'm going to spend my money.  Your money?  Is it more Rick's money, than anyone in the room?
It's just money.  

And to use it incorrectly in a time of gross trouble on a planet, if all you're going to do is support a hard rock metal group, I'd rather you starve.  It comes on the stage like this.  And all those teenagers are out there in the audience, you know, giving it this.  Is that what you want your children to be?  Satan's goats?  Well, of course you don't.  Of course you don't.  

Well, let's put our funds, and our abundance into something worthwhile.  Let's build a brotherhood, a global brotherhood for humanity, so that it can once, once in its full existence, hold its head proud before Creator.  
I intend to do it, and together we're going to get it done.  And we're going to love every minute of it.  

Let's go home.  Any questions?  I would have questions.  

[Wally] Is there anything we should be doing that should be talked about?  So we know what we should be doing. Or we should be still waiting, or thinking...

[Hatonn] You're still waiting until we can begin to have things happen. But be thinking.  Yes, indeed, be thinking.  

[Wally] I'm going to go.  Let me have some more.  I mean.  I guess this is probably the hardest thing for me to really believe that, that after fifty nine, almost sixty years of dreaming, that actually to be able to really start moving without limits, and I guess that was one thing that, that prior to the beginning of this meeting yesterday, I just wanted to come with out expectations, and without any limitations, because I felt with my heart, and being, and soul that the work that you guys had been doing for this last bit of time, was going to be that fundamental accomplishment that will actually transform the people of this world, and this world itself from darkness into light, from hate to love, and from death to immortality.  And to be a living human being, to be aware that I'm living, and that nothing surpasses this life, and that life is God, and that God breathes in and out, and I breathe in and out, and I'm One with my Father.

I can't, with words, adequately express the gratitude, and the appreciation that I feel for the experience of life that's been given to me, and I must say, with at least what I've done with the experience of my life, up until this point.  It's immensely satisfying, and gratifying to be here, and I'm just so grateful to be here. Thank you. 

[Hatonn] Well, we're grateful to have you here.  And you're not alone.  You are not alone.  And it's coming together now, all over the globe.  Pods here, pods there.  And the elite know.  Their time is limited, and they're trying to make their own decisions about how they handle things.  They're not denying what we have.

They would rather it work out a little bit better for them.  And we don't mind working it out better for them.  We really don't mind working it out better for them!  You don't want a collapse!  You want to grow, and build.  They will fall of their own volition.  We're not at war, and we must get rid of that concept.  And yes, we will do it.  And we do have to have the spiritual strength to do it.  On the other hand, don't become filled with spiritualism.  That immobilizes you also, because you become some pious do-nothing.  

Be yourself!  Be strong!  Be what God has endowed you to be!  And I wonder if you're ready to hear it.  Equal!  I finally heard EJ say something to these women.  They're there, and they are powerful people.  They know everybody who's anybody.  And they're now getting so humble, and they want this, and they want this, and oh... our father been sent... and they're practically going to lollygag on the floor.  While he gags.  Stop this!  Shut up!  You know, eye to eye now.  No more of this father crap.  It’s your, and it’s me.  And our father, our father...

Tape ended abruptly at 40:26
